column2: 好主意，佛萊迪。那片蝕刻玻璃鏡上的光譜線，對懂得判讀的人來說能透露不少訊息。

column1: The gaseous spectroscope doesn't work unless the alcohol lamp is lit and the spectroscope has been placed in front of the lamp.
column2: 除非先點燃酒精燈，並把光譜儀擺在燈前，否則氣體光譜儀無法運作。

column1: Crucible
column2: 坩堝

column1: The crucible is only for melting pure, or nearly pure, metals.
column2: 坩堝只能用來熔化純金屬，或接近純度的金屬。

column1: Before leaving your lab, you remove the medallion from the crucible.
column2: 離開實驗室前，你把獎章從坩堝裡取出。

column1: You've got a crucible of molten silver! You shouldn't leave the lab until you figure out something to do with it.
column2: 坩堝裡有一鍋熔化的銀！在想出該拿它怎麼辦之前，你不該離開實驗室。

column1: You quickly pour the molten silver into the empty mold.
column2: 你迅速把熔銀倒進空模具裡。

column1: You can't sleep. You're too restless. Maybe because it's broad daylight.
column2: 你睡不著，心裡靜不下來。也許是因為現在是大白天。

column1: You'll never get back to sleep now. There's trouble afoot, and that gnaws at your gut. Or maybe it's that whole pouch of "Gummy Buffalo" you had just before you went to sleep!
column2: 你現在肯定睡不回去了。有麻煩正在醞釀，啃噬著你的胃。也可能是睡前吃下那一整包「水牛軟糖」的緣故！

column1: It's your Seamy Pasturepedic 100% rawhide-filled mattress. You bumped into it at a sidewalk sale. And fractured your shin. They let you take it home, which was cheaper than paying to have your leg fixed.
column2: 這是你的「邋遢牧場牌」百分百生皮填充床墊。你在路邊拍賣時撞上了它，撞裂了小腿骨。對方讓你把床墊帶回家，因為那比幫你治腿便宜多了。

column1: You don't really need those grooming aids, you're a Western-style hero. Your hair is always in place and your gums are always sparkling pink.
column2: 你其實不需要那些梳妝用品，你可是西部風格的英雄。頭髮永遠服服貼貼，牙齦永遠粉嫩發亮。

column1: Your grooming aids:
column2: 你的梳妝用品：

column1: This is no time to sit and read books. You're in the middle of a stirring saga of the Old West!
column2: 現在不是坐下看書的時候。你正身處一場蕩氣迴腸的西部傳奇之中！

column1: A lovely old glass-fronted bookcase, containing some of your favorite leisure-time reading material:
column2: 一個古樸的玻璃門書櫃，裡頭放著你最愛的休閒讀物：

column1: Now let's see. Where wuz I? Oh, that's right. Madame Ovaree begged and pleaded with Freddy to either leave town or take up his ol' gunslingin' ways, sumpthin' which Freddy was just a mite reluctant to consider. So they decided to sleep on it, and though they didn't get much sleep, Freddy did mull it over somewhat.
column2: 讓我瞧瞧，講到哪了？喔對了。歐薇莉夫人苦苦哀求佛萊迪，要嘛離開小鎮，要嘛重操他當年的槍手舊業，這件事佛萊迪其實有點不太願意考慮。於是他們決定先睡一覺再說，雖然沒睡多少，佛萊迪倒是把這事琢磨了一番。

column1: Penelope... Coarsegold... Madame Ovaree...
column2: 潘妮洛普……粗金鎮……歐薇莉夫人……

column1: <cough cough>
column2: <咳咳>

column1: It's been so long since you moved this chair, it seems to have become one with the floor. How zen!
column2: 這張椅子好久沒挪動了，看起來已經跟地板融為一體。真是禪意十足！

column1: You ran across this desk chair outside the General Store. In so doing, you tripped and knocked out two teeth. You threatened to sue the owner, but he placated you by giving you this fine chair to keep.
column2: 你在雜貨店外撞見這張書桌椅。撞的時候還絆了一跤，磕掉兩顆牙。你揚言要告老闆，結果他送你這張好椅子當賠罪，你就消氣了。

column1: You pick up the claim check, your hand trembling with the memory of the last time you wore the boots that you traded for it... that monster, Kenny the Kid, looking down at you and laughing as your ear bled in the hot sun...
column2: 你拿起提貨單，手不禁顫抖，想起上次穿這雙靴子換來的回憶……那個惡棍小鬼肯尼，居高臨下看著你，在烈日下笑著看你耳朵流血……

column1: It's a claim check... for a pair of boots! Your old cowboy boots from... the Before Time? Before "The Accident?" Could it be?? That's what you get for not opening this drawer for the past decade.
column2: 這是一張提貨單……用來領一雙靴子！是你「從前」……在「那場意外」之前的舊牛仔靴嗎？難道是？這就是你十年沒開這個抽屜的下場。

column1: This side of the armoire doesn't open. It must've been built by the same yahoo that built the outhouse by ReBoot Hill!
column2: 衣櫃的這一側打不開。八成是蓋「重開機丘」那間茅廁的同一個蠢蛋做的！

column1: You picked up this old armoire at the farmer's market. It gave you a hernia. So instead of paying the doctor's bills, the owner let you keep it.
column2: 你在農夫市集買下這個舊衣櫃，結果搬出了疝氣。老闆讓你留下衣櫃，抵掉醫藥費。

column1: Look, your closet full of pharmacist duds.
column2: 瞧，你滿櫃子的藥劑師行頭。

column1: The armoire door is wide open, displaying your outfits for all the world to see and admire.
column2: 衣櫃門大開，你的行頭展示在世人眼前，供人欣賞。

column1: The drawer at the base of your armoire is empty, except for a few stray black widows.
column2: 衣櫃底部的抽屜是空的，只剩幾隻遊蕩的黑寡婦蜘蛛。

column1: It's the open drawer of your armoire, currently exceedingly empty and devoid of stuff.
column2: 這是衣櫃打開的抽屜，目前空得徹底，什麼都沒有。

column1: You take your old gunslinger clothes and your "Good Guy Model" Stetson hat.
column2: 你拿起舊日的槍手服裝，還有那頂「好人款」牛仔氈帽。

column1: Your old hat and gunslinging outfit! And ... mmmm! ... it smells of camphor!
column2: 你的舊帽子和槍手裝束！而且……嗯……聞起來有樟腦味！

column1: You take the key.
column2: 你拿起了鑰匙。

column1: Hot dawg, now we're gettin' somewhere.
column2: 呦呼，這下總算有點進展了。

column1: It's a key! Hot dawg, now we're gettin' somewhere.
column2: 是把鑰匙！呦呼，這下總算有點進展了。

column1: The dresser is artistically placed as it is. No need to move it.
column2: 這梳妝台的擺放本身就很有美感，不需要移動。

column1: You stumbled onto this big ol' dresser at a moving sale. And broke your toe. So rather than pay to have your toe fixed, the owner let you keep the dresser. In fact, you get ALL your furniture by accident!
column2: 你在搬家拍賣上撞見這個大梳妝台，還撞斷了腳趾。老闆讓你留下梳妝台，抵掉治腳趾的錢。說真的，你所有的家具都是這樣意外得來的！

column1: You'll hafta close the dresser drawer before you can do that. Damn these one-bedroom apartments.
column2: 你得先關上梳妝台抽屜才能這麼做。這種一房公寓真是狹小討厭。

column1: The drawer is empty, save for a few cobwebs, dust balls, and dead gnats. If you had some socks and underwear in there, they'd need washing pretty badly.
column2: 抽屜是空的，只剩幾張蜘蛛網、灰塵球和死掉的小蟲。要是裡頭真有襪子和內褲，恐怕早該拿去洗了。

column1: There you are, Freddy Pharkas, you are mostly indeed a picture of stately mysterious strangerness. Nobody will be positive to recognize you any now.
column2: 瞧瞧你，佛萊迪·法卡斯，此刻的你儼然是一副莊嚴神秘的陌生人模樣。現在沒人能篤定認出你了。

column1: Thanks for your help, Srini. Coarsegold owes you a debt of gratitude it can never repay. If anyone asks, Freddy Pharkas has left town. And if I don't come out of this alive, the Pharmacy is yours.
column2: 謝謝你的幫忙，斯里尼。粗金鎮欠你一份永遠還不清的恩情。要是有人問起，就說佛萊迪·法卡斯已經離開小鎮了。要是我這趟出去回不來，藥局就是你的了。

column1: That is of a true generous nature you are displaying, Freddy Pharkas. As for me, I would like to open a pharmacy on the reservation among my people. But whether that is fated to be or not is in the hands of someone who is not I. Luck be with you, Freddy Pharkas. I am proud now.
column2: 你展現出的，正是真正慷慨的天性，佛萊迪·法卡斯。至於我，我希望能在保留區為我的族人開一間藥局。但這是否是命中注定，並非由我來決定。祝你好運，佛萊迪·法卡斯。此刻我深感驕傲。

column1: With your boots, your clothes, your guns cleaned and loaded, your silver ear, and your lucky neckerchief, you're ready to get dressed and assume your identity as the Gunslingin' Stranger. You return to your penthouse suite, high atop the glittering Pharkas Pharmacy in Beautiful Downtown Coarsegold.
column2: 靴子穿上，衣服備妥，槍枝擦亮上膛，銀耳裝好，幸運領巾繫上，你準備好換上「槍手陌生人」的身分了。你回到頂樓套房，高踞於閃亮的法卡斯藥局之上，坐落在粗金鎮美麗的市中心。

column1: It's a reading lamp. Don't bother it while it's reading.
column2: 這是一盞閱讀燈。它在看書的時候別去打擾它。

column1: While browsing at a second-hand store, you were struck by this particularly sturdy reading lamp. The result was a mild concussion. The guy who'd accidentally dropped it out of the second-story window was very apologetic, and rather than pay for the skull surgery, offered to let you take the lamp home with you.
column2: 你在二手商店逛街時，被這盞特別堅固的閱讀燈砸中，落得輕微腦震盪。不小心從二樓窗戶把它丟下來的那個人非常抱歉，與其付顱骨手術的錢，他寧可讓你把燈帶回家。

column1: There's nothing under there but more moose.
column2: 那下面除了更多的麋鹿，什麼都沒有。

column1: Your authentic moose-skin rug looks very attractive with those eyeglasses on it! It would've been a mite less lumpy if somebody'd remembered to skin the moose first.
column2: 你那張正宗麋鹿皮地毯上擺著眼鏡，看起來相當有型！要是當初有人記得先把麋鹿剝皮，地毯會少一點凹凸不平。

column1: There's nothing left in the drawer you can use.
column2: 抽屜裡沒有你能用的東西了。

column1: You've got nowhere to take it.
column2: 你沒有地方可以拿它去。

column1: While window-shopping in Chowchilla, your eye fell on this plain but serviceable nightstand. They got your eye back in, but the owner didn't want to touch the nightstand anymore. He let you keep it.
column2: 你在喬奇拉逛街時，一眼就相中這個樸素卻實用的床頭櫃──看到眼珠子都掉出來了。他們把眼珠裝了回去，但老闆從此不想再碰這櫃子，索性讓你留著。

column1: Don't move it, it's covering up the results of a failed experiment involving Madame Ovaree, a dog, a melon and a Tibetan hanging basket.
column2: 別移動它，它正蓋著一場失敗實驗的殘局，牽涉到歐薇莉夫人、一隻狗、一顆哈密瓜和一個西藏吊籃。

column1: A small picture of your Mother, rest her soul. If only she could have lived to see you now: an ex-gunslinging pharmacist in Coarsegold, California. She'd have had a heart attack and died.
column2: 一張你母親的小照片，願她安息。要是她能活著看到現在的你——一個曾是槍手、如今在加州粗金鎮當藥劑師的男人，恐怕會嚇到心臟病發身亡。

column1: Sturdy timbers. Solid construction. Indoor plumbing. Any of those would be an improvement!
column2: 堅固的木料。紮實的建造。室內水管。有這些哪一樣都算是進步！

column1: This is your cozy li'l bedroom.
column2: 這是你溫馨的小臥室。

column1: I wonder how this would look if I added a little paneling?
column2: 不知道加點壁板裝潢，這裡會變成什麼樣子？

column1: You usually try to avoid talking to your surroundings.
column2: 你通常會盡量避免跟周遭環境講話。

column1: FIRE! FIRE! Freddy Pharkas, please come urgently!
column2: 火災！火災！佛萊迪·法卡斯，請火速前來！

column1: Whu... what's wrong, Srini?
column2: 什……什麼事，斯里尼？

column1: A tragedy is becoming!! The Assay Office is aflame! She is burning with a might most severe! The Pharmacy may be next alighted! Get dressed as soon as possible!
column2: 一場悲劇正在成形！！驗金所著火了！火勢猛烈異常！藥局可能是下一個遭殃的！請盡速更衣！

column1: I am dressed. I don't own pajamas.
column2: 我已經穿好衣服了。我沒有睡衣。

column1: Take mine! No, wait, there is not time to perform such an effort. Just hurry and scheme in such a way so as to extinguish the most threatening fire!
column2: 穿我的吧！不，等等，沒時間做這種事了。快去想辦法，把那最危急的火撲滅！

column1: You can only take the stairs up or down. You can't take them anywhere else.
column2: 你只能沿著樓梯往上或往下走，沒辦法走到別的地方。

column1: The stairs lead down to your back office.
column2: 樓梯往下通往你的後方辦公室。

column1: Careful, that trunk is DANGEROUS! And you've got the scars to prove it.
column2: 小心，那個皮箱很危險！你身上的疤痕就是證明。

column1: Your Dad unloaded his old vaudeville trunk on you. Not on purpose, though; he didn't know you were standing underneath when he unloaded it off the top of the stagecoach. Ever since then, you've had brief blackouts. But what the hey? Free trunk, right?
column2: 你老爸把他那口舊雜耍皮箱丟給了你。不是故意的啦，他從驛馬車頂上卸下箱子時，沒發現你正站在下面。從那之後，你就時不時會短暫昏迷。但管它的，反正箱子是白拿的，對吧？

column1: You need to close the armoire first. What do you think this is, the Embassy Suites?
column2: 你得先把衣櫃關上。你以為這裡是什麼高級套房飯店嗎？

column1: There is nothing more in your trunk.
column2: 你的皮箱裡沒有別的東西了。

column1: Salvatore O'Hanahan, town barber/dentist/bootblack, is hard at work on his customer, Eb Sorbeen, Jr. Salvatore also happens to be the only Irish-Italian in town!
column2: 鎮上的理髮師兼牙醫兼擦鞋匠薩瓦多·歐哈納翰，正在替顧客小艾伯·索賓賣力服務。薩瓦多恰好也是鎮上唯一的愛爾蘭裔義大利人！

column1: Salvatore O'Hanahan is taking a moment to sing a few bars from "The Barber of Seville."
column2: 薩瓦多·歐哈納翰正抽空哼唱幾句《塞維利亞的理髮師》。

column1: How's business, Sal? Seems like you always have a customer these days.
column2: 生意怎麼樣，阿薩？這陣子好像總是有顧客上門。

column1: Notta so good, Freddy. My earnings are up, butta ma profits are down!
column2: 不太好呦，佛萊迪。偶的營收是漲了，可是利潤卻掉了！

column1: That's too bad, Sal. Do you have any ideas about how to increase business?
column2: 真可惜，阿薩。你有沒有什麼點子能拉抬生意？

column1: Well, ah do have one idea. I've been thinkin' 'bout providin' dirty reading material for ma customers ta read whilst they wait.
column2: 呃，偶是有一個點子。偶一直在想，要不要弄點色色的讀物，讓顧客等待的時候可以看看。

column1: But your customers are illiterate!
column2: 可是你的顧客都不識字啊！

column1: Yup, an' they cain't read so good neither!
column2: 對啊，他們也看不懂字！

column1: Howdy, Sal! How's things?
column2: 嘿，阿薩！最近怎麼樣？

column1: I canna complain, Freddy! I'm-a gettin' plenty business.
column2: 沒啥好抱怨的，佛萊迪！偶生意好得很。

column1: Did you notice that the Hotel's been shut down?
column2: 你注意到旅館被停業了嗎？

column1: Yeah, I noticed that this-a morning! What's up with THAT? Who'sa-da genius who came up with THAT?
column2: 有啊，偶今早才注意到！這是搞什麼？是哪個天才想出這種主意的？

column1: Well, if you hear anything about it, let me know, willya?
column2: 嗯，要是你聽到什麼消息，記得告訴我，好嗎？

column1: Hey, you got it, Freddy! Anna same to you! You hear anything, you letta me know! I be right here, uppa to my arms in this guy's head!
column2: 嘿，沒問題，佛萊迪！你也一樣！你聽到什麼也要告訴偶！偶就在這兒，手都埋進這位客人的腦袋裡了！

column1: Sal...
column2: 阿薩……

column1: Gimme a break, Freddy! I gotta customers. Don't you gotta customers?
column2: 饒了偶吧，佛萊迪！偶還有顧客呢。你不也有顧客要顧？

column1: Well, I suppose so.
column2: 呃，這倒也是。

column1: Then do me a favor, hokay? You come-a back when you gotta news, hokay? I gotta make some headway onna this guy! Hey! I made a funny! "Gotta make some headway." Get it? Get it?
column2: 那就幫偶個忙，好嗎？有消息再回來找偶，好嗎？偶得在這位客人「頭」上有點進展了！嘿！偶說了個笑話！「頭上有進展」，聽懂了沒？聽懂了沒？

column1: Got it.
column2: 懂了。

column1: Good!
column2: 很好！

column1: Sal, all hell has broken loose.
column2: 阿薩，外頭全亂套了。

column1: What's-a da problem, Freddy, me lad?
column2: 出什麼問題了，佛萊迪，小老弟？

column1: The Sheriff shut down Smithie. Then he shut me down, too. Some crap about being a fire hazard.
column2: 警長把鐵匠史密的店關了，接著也把我的藥局停業了。說什麼有火災風險的鬼話。

column1: Say it ain't so, Freddy!
column2: 別說是真的，佛萊迪！

column1: 'Fraid so, Sal. And if that weren't bad enough, the whole town's bein' gassed by flatulent horses. Someone must've poisoned the horse's feed.
column2: 恐怕是真的，阿薩。而且還不只如此，整個鎮上都被馬屁薰得受不了。一定有人在馬飼料裡下了毒。

column1: Tell-a me about it! I been stuffin' hair in the door jamb, tryin' to keep the stench out! You gotta do sumpin', Freddy!
column2: 可不是嘛！偶一直在門縫塞頭髮，想擋住那股臭味！你得想想辦法啊，佛萊迪！

column1: But... but I'm just a pharmacist!
column2: 可是……可是我只是個藥劑師啊！

column1: Yes, and the horses, they just have gas, right? So do sumpin' about it!
column2: 對啊，那些馬也只是脹氣而已，不是嗎？所以你就想個辦法解決啊！

column1: OK! I'm thinking, I'm thinking!
column2: 好啦！我在想了，我在想了！

column1: You can breathe easier now, Sal. I took care of that problem with the horses. Turns out somebody put lentils in the feed! Ever hear of anything so dastardly?
column2: 現在你可以鬆口氣了，阿薩。馬的問題我解決了。原來是有人在飼料裡摻了扁豆！你聽過這麼陰險的事嗎？

column1: Atsa devious alright, Freddy! But now whatta ya gonna do about that-a stampede headin' for town?
column2: 這招真夠陰的，佛萊迪！但你現在要怎麼對付那群衝向鎮上的蝸牛暴走潮？

column1: What am I gonna do about it? Why is it always ME?
column2: 我能怎麼辦？為什麼每次都是我？

column1: Sure 'n yer the smart one, Freddy Pharkas... the one in control, the one we're all watchin' and countin' on. You're the protagonist here, the rest of us are just extras. Now go be a bonnie lad and STOP THAT STAMPEDE!
column2: 那是因為你是聰明的那一個，佛萊迪·法卡斯……你是掌控全局的人，是我們所有人在看、在指望的人。你才是這故事的主角，我們其他人不過是路人甲乙丙。現在去當個好孩子，把那波暴走潮擋下來！

column1: Sal! Great news! I derailed the snail stampede. Those snails are history.
column2: 阿薩！好消息！我把蝸牛暴走潮攔下來了。那些蝸牛已經成為歷史了。

column1: Atsa my boy! Your mama mus' be so proud.
column2: 這才是偶認識的小子！你老媽一定引以為傲。

column1: Now if I can just figure out WHAT'S going on in town... and how to get an Indian off an anthill!
column2: 現在只要我能搞清楚鎮上到底發生了什麼事……還有要怎麼把一個印地安人從蟻丘上弄下來就好了！

column1: Well, the former problem, she sounds like-a very tough problem. But the latter problem, she sounds pretty easy!
column2: 嗯，前面那個問題聽起來相當棘手。但後面那個問題，聽起來倒是挺簡單的！

column1: Congratulate me, Sal. I've got an assistant now!
column2: 恭喜我吧，阿薩。我現在有助手了！

column1: So I hear! Now mebbe you can do somethin' about the town's water supply, eh?
column2: 偶聽說了！那你現在能不能想想辦法解決一下鎮上的供水問題？

column1: One thing at a time! I'm on the case, okay?
column2: 一件一件來！我正在處理，好嗎？

column1: Sal, I'm heading out of town for a while.
column2: 阿薩，我要暫時離開鎮上一陣子。

column1: But you were doing such a good job, m'lad! Fixin' the water supply, puttin' out the fire... we need ye, Freddy!
column2: 可是你做得那麼好啊，小老弟！修好供水、撲滅大火……我們需要你，佛萊迪！

column1: I know, but now the Sheriff and the Banker are out to get me. It's not safe for me in town any more.
column2: 我知道，但現在警長和銀行家都盯上我了。鎮上對我來說已經不安全了。

column1: You wan' me to talk to 'em for you? Maybe Salvatore throws his weight around a li'l, eh?
column2: 要不要偶幫你去跟他們談談？也許讓薩瓦多施點壓力，嗯？

column1: No, no, no. It's not worth the trouble. I'll be back, Sal. And if I'm not... you take care.
column2: 不、不、不。不值得這麼麻煩。我會回來的，阿薩。要是我沒回來……你自己保重。

column1: 'Ay, you take care, too, you a nize boy.
column2: 嘿，你也保重啊，你這個好孩子。

column1: Hey, I put a fire out last night and saved the town. Proud of me?
column2: 嘿，我昨晚撲滅了一場火，救了整個鎮。以我為榮嗎？

column1: Of course I'm proud of you!
column2: 我當然以你為榮！

column1: Hey, Sal!
column2: 嘿，阿薩！

column1: 'Ey, that's Salvatore to you, stranger. What can I do for ye?
column2: 嘿，對你來說是「薩瓦多」，陌生人。有什麼能為你效勞的？

column1: Oh... that's right... um... I was here for a teeth cleanin'.
column2: 喔……對了……呃……我是來洗牙的。

column1: Sorry, I gotta customer gettin' "The Works." That's gonna take all day.
column2: 抱歉，偶有個客人要做「全套服務」，得花上一整天。

column1: Oh, no! He found an "All Day" sucker!
column2: 喔，不！他被纏上一整天了！

column1: Don't go out on the street, now, Salvatore! There's a lot of shootin' and nastiness goin' on out there!
column2: 薩瓦多，先別上街！外頭正在槍林彈雨、烏煙瘴氣呢！

column1: Thanks for the warnin', stranger! Much obliged!
column2: 謝謝你的提醒，陌生人！感激不盡！

column1: (MUTTERING) |c1|'ey, hands off while I'm a-workin' onna this guy!|c|
column2: （喃喃自語） |c1|嘿，偶在幫這位客人服務的時候，手別亂碰！|c|

column1: Salvatore sings away, unmindful of your poking and prodding.
column2: 薩瓦多自顧自地唱著歌，沒留意到你在戳戳弄弄。

column1: Ah, no thankee, lad. I had a wee bit of that stuff last night, anna whoo boy, I'm-a payin' today.
column2: 啊，不用了，謝謝，小老弟。偶昨晚喝了一點那玩意，唉呀，今天可有得受了。

column1: I don't know nuttin' about fillin' no prescriptions, Miz Scarl... I meanna, Freddy!
column2: 偶對配藥這種事一竅不通啦，史卡……偶是說，佛萊迪！

column1: Not awhile I'm a-workin', Freddy! I wouldn't want to be operatin' heavy machinery like this chair while under the influence, now, would I?
column2: 偶在工作的時候不行，佛萊迪！偶總不能醉醺醺地操作這張椅子這種重機械吧，是不是？

column1: Nice job, Freddy! I hope you gotta big points for that!
column2: 幹得好，佛萊迪！希望你因此拿到不少分數！

column1: Yepper!
column2: 沒錯！

column1: I wish I'd-a thoughta that.
column2: 真希望偶自己想得到這一招。

column1: Atsa nice offer, Freddy, butta my hemors aren't a-rhoiding.
column2: 這提議不錯，佛萊迪，不過偶的痔瘡沒在發作啦。

column1: I'm-a not drinkin' beer, it throws off my clippin'.
column2: 偶不喝啤酒的，那會影響偶剪東西的手感。

column1: It's water, not beer.
column2: 這是水，不是啤酒。

column1: Ho, you thinkin' I'm-a just born offa da boat? I can tell-a da difference between water anna beer. I just lookit the label!
column2: 哦，你當偶是剛下船的菜鳥嗎？水跟啤酒偶還分得出來啦。偶就看看標籤而已！

column1: You no needa my charity, Freddy. You doin' hokay.
column2: 你不需要偶的施捨，佛萊迪。你過得挺好的。

column1: Say, that thing, she's-a sharper than mosta my dental instruments! You wanna trade for ol' rusty drill?
column2: 說真的，那東西比偶大部分的牙科器材都利！要不要拿來換偶那支生鏽的老鑽頭？

column1: Nah, I don't think so. Thanks for the offer, though.
column2: 不了，我看還是不用了。謝謝你的好意就是了。

column1: Some nize chunks-a charcoal. You wouldn't be takin' 'em from the Blacksmith's forge, would ya now, laddie-a?
column2: 這幾塊木炭挺不錯的。你該不會是從鐵匠的爐子那兒順來的吧，小老弟？

column1: Smithie's gone, Sal. He hit the trail.
column2: 鐵匠史密走了，阿薩。他上路離開了。

column1: Oh, I'm-a sorry to see 'em go... him bein' such a fine broth of a smithie, too.
column2: 喔，偶還真捨不得他走……他可是個挺不錯的鐵匠呢。

column1: 'Atsa nice strop! Good for sharpenin' blades! But I gotta whetstone, I no needa da strop. Thanks anyways!
column2: 這磨刀皮帶不錯！很適合磨利刀刃！不過偶有磨刀石了，不需要皮帶。還是謝了！

column1: I'm-a not needin' that gas mask, laddie, as long as I'm-a stayin' inside!
column2: 只要偶待在屋裡，就用不著那個防毒面具，小老弟！

column1: Don't be givin' it to me, lad. I'm-a not have any problems inna da lower regions!
column2: 別給偶那個，小老弟。偶下面那一帶可沒什麼毛病！

column1: I don't needa da snails. I'm-a da vegetarian.
column2: 偶不需要蝸牛。偶是吃素的。

column1: 'Atsa not necessary, Freddy. You don't owe me any money! You haven't been in for a haircut or tooth job for months!
column2: 這沒必要，佛萊迪。你又不欠偶錢！你都好幾個月沒來剪頭髮或看牙了！

column1: No-tanka you, Freddy, lad! You gotta Chianti?
column2: 不用了，謝啦，佛萊迪！你有奇揚地紅酒嗎？

column1: Nope... sorry.
column2: 沒有……抱歉。

column1: Too bad. 'Ow about a wee bit o' whisky, then?
column2: 真可惜。那來一小杯威士忌怎麼樣？

column1: Sorry, none of the hard stuff.
column2: 抱歉，烈酒我這沒有。

column1: Atsa always the way, eh? Same all over.
column2: 老是這樣，是吧？到哪都一樣。

column1: Sorry, this-a week I only accept aluminum.
column2: 抱歉，偶這禮拜只收鋁製品。

column1: Sure 'n that key notta belongin' to me!
column2: 那把鑰匙可不是偶的！

column1: What, you wanna climb uppa me? Wanna see the toppa my head? Wotsa big deal?
column2: 怎樣，你想爬到偶身上？想看偶的頭頂是吧？有什麼大不了的？

column1: Some hanka rope you're havin' there, laddie.
column2: 你手上那捆繩子挺不賴的嘛，小老弟。

column1: I was going to tie you up.
column2: 我本來是要把你綁起來的。

column1: Ah, couldn't be lettin' ye do that, now. Nope, nope.
column2: 啊，偶可不能讓你這麼做。不行，不行。

column1: 'Ay, I'm-a notta herd o' cattle! You should be usin' that lasso somewheres else, lad.
column2: 嘿，偶又不是一群牛！那條套索該用在別的地方，小老弟。

column1: I'm-a no needin' that, Freddy! I'm-a sterilizin' my water wi' whisky!
column2: 偶用不著那個，佛萊迪！偶都用威士忌來消毒水的！

column1: 'Ay, now, we traded fair 'n square! I love-a doze French Postcards, I'm-a keepin' 'em! You keep-a da laughing gas! Feh!
column2: 嘿，偶們可是公平交易的！偶喜歡這些法國明信片，偶要留著！你就留著那個笑氣吧！哼！

column1: Some pile o' baking soda you've got there, lad! Atsa real nize!
column2: 你那堆小蘇打粉還真不少，小老弟！挺不錯的！

column1: You hand Salvatore your French Postcards.
column2: 你把法國明信片交給薩瓦多。

column1: Your customers may not be able to read, Salvatore, but I bet they would enjoy looking at pictures!
column2: 薩瓦多，你的顧客也許不識字，但我敢說他們會喜歡看圖片！

column1: No, they're not interested in... WAIT A MINUTE! What in the hell are those girls doing?!
column2: 不，她們沒興趣……等等！那些女孩到底在幹什麼啊？！

column1: I'm not sure, but I don't think it's legal on this side of the Sierra Nevada!
column2: 我不確定，不過我猜內華達山脈這一側大概不合法吧！

column1: Well now, your exceptional generosity's gotta be reciprocated! Could I be interestin' you in a free shave?
column2: 哎呀，你這麼大方，俺總得回報一下才行！要不要俺幫你免費刮個鬍子啊？

column1: No, thank you, Sal.
column2: 不用了，謝謝你，阿薩。

column1: Then, how about a free wisdom tooth extraction?
column2: 那，免費幫你拔顆智齒如何？

column1: Oh, mine are already out. Had 'em pulled in the dental department while I was in college. Needed the extra money for tuition.
column2: 喔，我的智齒早就拔光了。唸大學那時候在牙科部拔的，那時候缺學費啊。

column1: Well, then, lemme see... watta I got in here that'd be a suitable swap?
column2: 好吧，那讓俺瞧瞧……看看這裡有什麼能拿來換的啊？

column1: Why, thank you, Salvatore. Perhaps I can use this in some of my experiments.
column2: 哎呀，謝了，阿薩。說不定這個能用在我的實驗裡。

column1: This-a no moustache wax! I dinna ken what kinda wax it is, either!
column2: 這個不是鬍鬚蠟啊！俺也不知道這到底是什麼蠟！

column1: Nize-a switchblade! Now be a good laddie and put that thing away.
column2: 好一把彈簧刀啊！乖孩子，把那玩意兒收起來吧。

column1: You aim the pistol at Salvatore.
column2: 你把手槍對準薩瓦多。

column1: 'Ay, what am I ever done to YOU, eh? I gotta wife anna kids at home! I'm-a hardworkin' shlub! I gotta no money! I was a-gonna retire soon, watch-a my kids grow up and move away, watch-a my wife growin' old and wrinkled and crabby. I was a-plannin' to die atta home, a poor anna broken man.
column2: 哎呀，俺到底是招你惹你了啊？俺家裡還有老婆孩子呢！俺就是個苦命的打工仔啊！俺什麼錢都沒有！俺本來還想快點退休，看著孩子長大搬出去，看著俺老婆變老變皺變兇，俺本來打算就這樣窮窮苦苦地死在家裡啊。

column1: You're right. I can't do it. I won't do it.
column2: 你說得對。我下不了手。我不幹了。

column1: You holster your pistol.
column2: 你把手槍收回槍套。

column1: No, waitta momento... come-a to think on it, maybe it would be quicker anna more painless this way. C'mon, shoota me.
column2: 不，等一下……仔細想想，說不定這樣反而比較快、比較不痛。來吧，開槍打俺吧。

column1: No, no, you were right the first time. Just forget it.
column2: 不不不，你剛剛的想法才對。這件事就算了吧。

column1: Somma friend!
column2: 算什麼朋友啊！

column1: Mmm, atta pie, she's-a looking sum good!
column2: 嗯，這派看起來真不賴啊！

column1: Wanna trade for something?
column2: 要不要交換點什麼啊？

column1: No thanks! I'm-a tryin' to watch-a my weight!
column2: 不用了！俺正在控制體重呢！

column1: I'm-a not thirsty. Already hadda twenty cupsa coffee today, and ho boy, I'm-a bit shaky already!
column2: 俺不渴。今天已經喝了二十杯咖啡了，天哪，俺現在手都在抖啊！

column1: Sure 'n begorrah, atsa' the Sheriff's gun cleaning-a kit!
column2: 哎呀我的媽呀，這是警長的槍械保養工具組啊！

column1: Hey, you-a no gunslinger! What you do with-a those?
column2: 嘿，你又不是槍手！拿這些要幹嘛啊？

column1: I thought I'd brush up on my shooting a bit... just in case.
column2: 我想說順便練練槍法……以防萬一。

column1: Well, laddie, be careful now! Don't be putting' yer eye out! I hardly know ye!
column2: 好啦孩子，小心點！別把自己眼睛戳瞎了！俺才剛認識你沒多久呢！

column1: I doan needa that, I'm-a no takin' any dental impressions today. But sure'n you're a nice lad for thinkin' of me.
column2: 俺不需要那個，今天沒在幫人做牙模啊。不過你會想到俺，真是個好孩子。

column1: 'Ay, you gotta prize! Bueno! 'ere's to yer!
column2: 哎呀，你中獎啦！太好了！敬你一杯！

column1: Them's a funny-shaped silver bullets you forgin' there!
column2: 你打的那些銀子彈形狀真奇怪啊！

column1: 'Ay, 'atsa nize silver ear you gotta there!
column2: 哎呀，你那個銀耳朵做得真不賴啊！

column1: Wottsa matta you? I'm-a look like a tailor to you? Faith 'n Begorrah, if I've been-a tellin' ya once, I've been-a tellin' you over anna over, I'm-a Dentist, Barber, Shoeshine, an' a Cobbler. I ain't no tailor!
column2: 你是怎麼回事啊？俺看起來像裁縫嗎？我的老天爺啊，俺都跟你講幾百遍了，俺是牙醫、理髮師、擦鞋匠兼補鞋匠，俺才不是裁縫！

column1: Sal, do you still have that pair of boots I dropped off for a shine? I know it's been about six years now, but I just remembered I left them here!
column2: 阿薩，我之前拿來給你擦的那雙靴子還在你這兒嗎？我知道已經過了大概六年了，可是我剛剛才想起來我放在這裡！

column1: Hmmm. Let me see... what's the number on this claim check? Lemme look under the counter here... Yep! Still here. Have 'em ready for ya next Tuesday!
column2: 嗯，讓俺瞧瞧……這張取件單的號碼是多少啊？俺找找看櫃檯下面……有了！還在這兒。下星期二幫你準備好！

column1: Never mind. I'll just take them as is.
column2: 算了，我就這樣拿走好了。

column1: Hey, don't worry 'bout the storage charges, okay?
column2: 嘿，別擔心保管費的事，好嗎？

column1: You keep 'em! I no gotta anymore beige-anna-turquoise shoe polish!
column2: 你留著吧！俺已經沒有米色配藍綠色的鞋油了！

column1: Atsa swell hankie you got there!
column2: 你那條手帕真不錯啊！

column1: It's not a hanky, it's a neckerchief.
column2: 這不是手帕，是牛仔領巾。

column1: If you say so, Freddy! Looksa-like a hankie to me! But hey, I'm-a no cowboy! I'm-a justa simple country barber/dentist/bootblack!
column2: 你說是就是吧，佛萊迪！俺看起來就像手帕啊！不過嘿，俺又不是牛仔！俺只是個鄉下的理髮師兼牙醫兼擦鞋匠而已！

column1: 'Ey, dis is a letter from-a Philip Graves! So? Ain't none-a my beeswax!
column2: 嘿，這是菲利普·葛雷夫斯寄來的信啊！那又怎樣？這不關俺的事！

column1: I don't needa da shovel. I'm-a not diggin' anything.
column2: 俺不需要那把鏟子。俺又沒在挖什麼東西。

column1: Woo boy, atsa' some stinkin' bagga sumpthin'!
column2: 哇塞，這是個臭烘烘的袋子裝著什麼東西啊！

column1: What, you wanna bag o' hair clippings? Sorry, 'at'd be violatin' the right to privacy o' me customers!
column2: 什麼，你要一袋剪下來的頭髮啊？抱歉，那樣會侵犯俺客人的隱私權啊！

column1: I understand.
column2: 我明白了。

column1: I wouldn't be wavin' that thing around if'n I were you, Freddy. It's notta gonna earn you no friends!
column2: 換做是俺，才不會拿那玩意兒到處揮舞呢，佛萊迪。那樣可交不到朋友啊！

column1: Hey! Like my silver-filled mold?
column2: 嘿！喜歡俺這個填滿銀子的模子嗎？

column1: 'Atsa-nize silver-filled mold, laddie. You musta be some-a hero!
column2: 這填銀模子真不賴啊，孩子。你一定是個大英雄吧！

column1: Not yet, but I'm workin' on it.
column2: 還不算是，不過我正在努力。

column1: Hey! That's-a wax ear inna clay! Pretty impressive!
column2: 嘿！那是黏土裡的蠟耳朵啊！真厲害！

column1: That mold, she's-a empty! What you gonna fill that with, Freddy?
column2: 這模子是空的啊！你打算拿什麼填進去啊，佛萊迪？

column1: If I knew what to fill it with, would I be here now?
column2: 我要是知道該填什麼，還會站在這裡嗎？

column1: Haha! Atsa' good one. I'm-a smilin' now.
column2: 哈哈！這句真妙。俺現在笑了啊。

column1: Nice-a sculpture! Wotta you call it?
column2: 這雕像真不賴啊！你叫它什麼名字？

column1: Um... I call it "Earwax Revisited."
column2: 呃……我叫它「耳垢重現」。

column1: Hunh. Well, I dunno nothin' about art, but I know what I like, anna I like your big lumpa earwax, whatever she's-a called.
column2: 哼。俺是不懂什麼藝術啦，但俺知道自己喜歡什麼，俺就是喜歡你這一大坨耳垢，不管它叫什麼名字啊。

column1: 'Ay, I'm as healthy as-a da horse! Maybe two-a horses! I dinna need any medicinations!
column2: 哎呀，俺健康得跟馬一樣！搞不好是兩匹馬！俺才不需要什麼藥呢！

column1: It's a shaving bowl and brush.
column2: 這是刮鬍碗和刷子。

column1: You thinkin' a growin' a beard?
column2: 你是在想要留鬍子嗎？

column1: No, I just wanted to see what I can do with this.
column2: 不是，我只是想看看這個能拿來做什麼。

column1: You can put it down, it's-a not yours.
column2: 你可以放下了，那不是你的東西。

column1: Although that comb storage jar is labeled "Disinfectant" you know for a fact that Louis Pasteur's recent research has proven that colored water will disinfect nothing!
column2: 雖然那個梳子保存罐上寫著「消毒液」，但你很清楚，路易·巴斯德最近的研究早就證明，有色的水根本消不了什麼毒！

column1: Hey, now, 'atsa my colorful comb water! Doan' be takin' it, I'll have-a to buy some-morea food coloring.
column2: 嘿，那可是俺的彩色梳水啊！別拿走，不然俺又得去買食用色素了。

column1: The label reads, "Dullcryme, A Big Dab'll Do Ya!"
column2: 標籤上寫著：「呆髮油——抹一大坨就夠啦！」

column1: Please keepa you hands off! I've only gotta two dabs left inna there.
column2: 拜託你的手拿開！俺裡面只剩兩坨了。

column1: This bottle is labeled "22 per cent alcohol by weight."
column2: 這瓶子上標示著「酒精含量佔重量百分之二十二」。

column1: 'Atsa my private stash of butterscotch schnapps. You wanna snort?
column2: 那是俺私藏的奶油糖利口酒啊。你要不要喝一口？

column1: No thank you, Salvatore, I'm a sarsaparilla man m'self.
column2: 不用了，謝謝你，阿薩，我這個人只喝沙士的。

column1: You are certainly happy it's not winter now. When Sal cranks up the heat in this baby, you can smell the memories of hundreds of miners, many of whom are now long dead... or at least smell that way!
column2: 你真慶幸現在不是冬天。要是阿薩把這地方的暖氣開到最大，你就能聞到幾百個礦工留下的回憶，他們有些人早就死了……至少聞起來是這樣啊！

column1: It's cold. Funny how rarely Salvatore cranks up the heat in this 110-degree weather.
column2: 好冷。真奇怪，這種華氏一百一十度的天氣，阿薩居然難得沒把暖氣開起來。

column1: Back in the old days, when Coarsegold was a bustling Gold Rush city packed with men returning from panning the mountain streams or heading for mountain claims, Sal often filled that bench with hirsute miners.
column2: 想當年，粗金鎮還是個熱鬧的淘金城市，擠滿了剛從山溪淘完金回來、或正要前往山區礦區的人，阿薩這張長凳上總是坐滿一堆毛髮濃密的礦工。

column1: Hey now, that's for the comfort of Salvatore's clients.
column2: 嘿，那可是為了讓阿薩的客人坐得舒服才擺的。

column1: Sal didn't really want a buffalo head mounted on his wall, but when it ran through the back of the building, he decided to just leave it.
column2: 阿薩其實並不想在牆上掛個水牛頭，不過既然它自己撞穿了後牆，阿薩就乾脆讓它留在那兒了。

column1: Hello, you majestic creature of the North American Plains!
column2: 你好啊，北美大平原上的雄偉生物！

column1: Flattery will get you nowhere with that beast.
column2: 對那頭野獸拍馬屁是沒有用的。

column1: Nice buffalo! Nice buffalo!
column2: 乖水牛！乖水牛！

column1: (Did he say "buffalo" or "Buff Al Lowe?")
column2: （他剛剛說的是「水牛」，還是「Buff Al Lowe」啊？）

column1: Once this lamp burned whale oil, but you know how hard it is to find whales around here?
column2: 這盞燈以前是燒鯨魚油的，不過你也知道，在這種地方要找到鯨魚有多難吧？

column1: This thing wouldn't work if you pumped 50,000 volts into it. Kinda like the Banker, the Sheriff, and most of the other folks in town!
column2: 就算灌五萬伏特電進去，這東西也不會動。跟這鎮上的銀行家、警長，還有大部分的人一樣啊！

column1: You're glad this pitcher is only used for storing water for hand washing. If you are thirsty, you'd be better off drinking from the horse troughs outside than trusting your life to this mess.
column2: 你很慶幸這個水壺只是拿來裝洗手水的。要是你渴了，與其把小命交給這團東西，不如去外面的馬槽喝水還比較保險。

column1: You tryin' to take-a my pitcher? No tenk-a-you, I'm-a camera shy!
column2: 你是想拿走俺的水壺啊？不用了謝謝，俺會怕鏡頭的啊！

column1: This is Salvatore's adjustable barber chair. Somebody ripped off the hand restraints during a tooth extraction.
column2: 這是阿薩的可調式理髮椅。曾經有人在拔牙的時候把固定手臂的皮帶扯掉了。

column1: You're not here for a trim.
column2: 你又不是來剪頭髮的。

column1: Upon close inspection, you realize Sal's counter is filled with little, teeny-tiny hairs... as is everything else in this place, including Sal!
column2: 你仔細一看才發現，阿薩的櫃檯上滿是細細小小的頭髮碎屑……這地方的每樣東西都是這樣，包括阿薩本人在內！

column1: You wanna some teeny-tiny little hairs? Sure, help-a-youself!
column2: 你想要一些細細小小的頭髮嗎？當然啊，自己拿吧！

column1: You actually decide you have no use for teeny-tiny hairs.
column2: 你想了想，還是覺得細碎頭髮對你沒什麼用。

column1: You see nothing in Sal's barbershop that you would consider useful.
column2: 你在阿薩的理髮店裡，看不出有什麼東西是有用的。

column1: There's nothing on the shelf worth steal... er, borrowing.
column2: 架子上沒有什麼值得偷……呃，借用的東西。

column1: This combination barbershop and dental emporium is under the exclusive proprietorship of Salvatore O'Hanahan, Coarsegold's only Italian/Irish barber.
column2: 這間理髮兼牙科複合商店，由薩瓦多·歐哈納翰獨家經營，他是粗金鎮唯一一位義大利/愛爾蘭混血理髮師。

column1: The words just aren't flowing freely, so you decide to shut up.
column2: 話說不出個所以然，你決定還是閉嘴算了。

column1: Please quit pokin' anna proddin' everything. You make-a me nervous.
column2: 拜託別再東戳西戳的了。你讓俺很緊張啊。

column1: Sal has a back door in case angry customers queue up out front to file lead complaints about their haircuts!
column2: 阿薩留了一道後門，以免氣呼呼的客人在店門口排隊，用子彈「投訴」他剪壞的髮型！

column1: This barbershop and dental emporium is under the exclusive proprietorship of Salvatore O'Hanahan, Coarsegold's only Italian/Irish barber.
column2: 這間理髮兼牙科商店，由薩瓦多·歐哈納翰獨家經營，他是粗金鎮唯一一位義大利/愛爾蘭混血理髮師。

column1: Doan you smudge-a my window!
column2: 別把俺的窗戶弄髒啊！

column1: This cabinet contains boring tonsorial equipment.
column2: 這個櫃子裡裝著一堆無聊的理髮器具。

column1: 'ey, leave-a my boring tonsorial equipment alone!
column2: 嘿，別碰俺那些無聊的理髮器具！

column1: You wouldn't care to give this place a "white glove" inspection... unless you wanted black gloves!
column2: 你大概不會想在這裡做「白手套」檢查……除非你想把手套弄成黑色的！

column1: You poke through the bottles to see what's what. Hmmm... preshave, aftershave, duringshave, notgonnashave, nevershave, wannashave and tooyoungtoshave. Remember what Al Lowe says: "shave early, shave often!"
column2: 你翻了翻那些瓶子看有些什麼。嗯……刮鬍前、刮鬍後、刮鬍中、不打算刮、永不刮、想刮，還有年紀太小不用刮。記住 Al Lowe 的名言：「早點刮，常常刮！」

column1: Sal used to keep this shelf filled with toiletries... until he found out there were no toilets in town!
column2: 阿薩以前都把這層架子擺滿盥洗用品……直到他發現這鎮上根本沒有廁所可用！

column1: There's nothing there except a few tonics 'n stuff that you sold Salvatore.
column2: 那裡除了你賣給阿薩的幾瓶藥水之類的東西，什麼也沒有。

column1: You catch a quick peek of yourself in the mirror and hope that no one noticed.
column2: 你偷瞄了一眼鏡子裡的自己，希望沒有人注意到。

column1: That's quite a mirror, Sal!
column2: 這面鏡子真不賴啊，阿薩！

column1: That'sa right. There ain' ah nobody believes justa how mucha costs to ship around de Isthmus!
column2: 那是當然。沒人會相信要繞過地峽運過來要花多少錢啊！

column1: Salvatore O'Hanahan has spared no expense installing a large expensive mirror for the convenience of his customers.
column2: 薩瓦多·歐哈納翰為了讓客人方便，不惜重金裝了這面又大又貴的鏡子。

column1: Those old boots look vaguely familiar.
column2: 那雙舊靴子看起來有點眼熟。

column1: Better not, they might belong to somebody.
column2: 還是別碰的好，那可能是別人的東西。

column1: Those are the naughty French postcards you gave to Salvatore!
column2: 那些是你之前送給阿薩的、有點色的法國明信片啊！

column1: Hey, no Indian giving!
column2: 嘿，送出去的東西可不能又要回來啊！

column1: That canister is labelled NO2.
column2: 那個罐子上標示著「NO2」。

column1: But it hasn't been offered to you! What is this attitude where you're trying to take everything that isn't nailed down? You can't get away with that, you know... especially not in the Old West.
column2: 可是根本沒人要給你啊！你這種看到什麼沒釘死就想拿走的態度是怎麼回事？你知道這樣是行不通的……尤其是在古老的西部時代。

column1: It's Salvatore O'Hanahan, looking very odd. That's it, he looks BACKWARDS. His part is on the wrong side and his facial features are reversed. You hope this "mirror" thing hasn't captured Salvatore's soul or anything.
column2: 是薩瓦多·歐哈納翰，看起來怪怪的。對，他整個人是「反過來」的。他的髮線分邊分反了，五官也左右顛倒。你希望這面「鏡子」沒有把阿薩的靈魂給吸走什麼的。

column1: Hey, Salvatore's reflection, how goes it?
column2: 嘿，阿薩的倒影，近來如何啊？

column1: ?ot gniklat uoy er'ohw ,yeH
column2: ？啊話說誰跟在你，嘿

column1: You! I mean... no, never mind.
column2: 你！我是說……不，沒事。

column1: It's only an image on glass. You can't take it, touch it, or even show it tender loving care.
column2: 那只是玻璃上的影像而已。你沒辦法拿走它、摸到它，甚至沒辦法好好疼惜它。

column1: Fletcher Castoria, the town plumber, sits here patiently, waiting for his turn in the chair. He's got nothing else to do, since nobody in Coarsegold has plumbing!
column2: 弗萊徹·卡斯托利亞，鎮上的水管工，耐心地坐在這裡，等著輪到他坐上理髮椅。反正他也沒別的事可做，畢竟粗金鎮根本沒人家裡有水管！

column1: Hey, Fletcher, how's the plumbing business?
column2: 嘿，弗萊徹，水管生意怎麼樣啊？

column1: He doesn't respond. Apparently he's too engrossed in reading the latest copy of the Skoocherdownan Examiner!
column2: 他沒有回應。看樣子他正專心讀著最新一期的《史庫齊當紀事報》，完全沒空理你！

column1: Please don't poke the plumber!
column2: 拜託別戳這位水管工！

column1: It's Whittlin' Willy. He's been here ever since you got to Coarsegold, and he hasn't aged a day. He's always been about 140 years old. He spins a mean yarn, and somehow he always seems to know what people did even when he wasn't in the room.
column2: 是削木威利。自從你來到粗金鎮，他就一直坐在這兒，一天都沒老過。他好像永遠都是一百四十歲左右。他很會編故事，而且不知怎麼的，就算他不在現場，也總是知道別人做了什麼事。

column1: It's m'secret powers, kid. I got X-ray vision and super hearing. 'Kay? Now scram.
column2: 這是俺的秘密力量啊，小子。俺有透視眼還有順風耳。行了吧？快滾。

column1: Hiya, Whittlin' Willy! How's the Whittlin' going?
column2: 嗨啊，削木威利！削木削得怎麼樣啊？

column1: Hiya, sonny! Just splendidly, thanks! I'm workin' on a ol' dead beached whale. 'Sgonna be m'best work to date.
column2: 嗨啊，小子！好得很，謝了！俺正在雕一隻擱淺死掉的老鯨魚。這會是俺目前最厲害的作品。

column1: Will it be for sale?
column2: 那會拿出來賣嗎？

column1: Will it be for sale? NO, it AIN'T gonna be fer sale! I'm an ARTISTE, dag nab it! 'Sides, iffn I hang onter it fer awhilst, mebbe it'll be worth sumpthin' someday. Now scram.
column2: 那會拿出來賣嗎？不，才不會拿出來賣咧！俺可是個藝術家，見鬼了！再說，俺要是留著久一點，搞不好哪天會值大錢。快滾吧。

column1: Hey there, Willy!
column2: 嘿，威利！

column1: That's WHITTLIN' Willy to you, son. Respeck yer olders.
column2: 對你來說，俺是「削木」威利，小子。尊敬一下長輩吧。

column1: Sorry.
column2: 抱歉。

column1: Fergit about it. Jus' get outta here, I'm whittlin'.
column2: 算了。快滾吧，俺在削木頭呢。

column1: Whittlin' Willy!
column2: 削木威利！

column1: Thunderation, boy! Ain't you got nothin' better ta do than interrupt me when I'm whittlin'?
column2: 我的老天爺啊，小子！你就沒別的事好做，非得在俺削木頭的時候來煩俺？

column1: Geez, sorry! It's just that you're a colorful old character, and I enjoy hearing tall tales and Western folklore from your oral traditions.
column2: 唉，抱歉！只是你這個老頭子挺有趣的，我很喜歡聽你口耳相傳的那些誇張故事跟西部民間傳說。

column1: Yew jus' keep my oral traditions outta this, son. Don't you gotta pharmacy to run? Ain't you got customers to wait on?
column2: 你就別扯上俺的口述傳統了，小子。你不是有藥局要顧嗎？不是有客人在等你嗎？

column1: I guess so...
column2: 我想也是……

column1: Then git along! Move 'em on! Head 'em up! Cut 'em out! Tie 'em in! Ride 'em in! Turn 'em in! Cut 'em out!
column2: 那就快滾吧！快動身！快出發！快趕路！快套繩！快騎馬！快轉向！快出發！

column1: Okay, okay.
column2: 好啦，好啦。

column1: Willy, you know what's going on out there?
column2: 威利，你知道外面是怎麼回事嗎？

column1: How could I MISS it, son? Whillikers, you step out there and it's like bein' smacked with a sack o'... welp, guess I don't hafta tell YOU, I smelt you comin' in!
column2: 俺怎麼可能沒注意到啊，小子？我的天哪，你一走出去，就像被一整袋……嗯，俺想俺也不必跟你解釋了，俺老遠就聞到你進來了！

column1: We gotta do something about it!
column2: 我們得想想辦法才行！

column1: I'm doin' my part, sonny. I'm whittlin' m'will.
column2: 俺已經在盡本分了，小子。俺在刻俺的遺囑呢。

column1: That's not good enough!
column2: 這樣可不夠啊！

column1: Hey, yer the pharmacist 'round here. We ain't got no veteran aryan. Them horses're obviously havin' some sorta lower gastro-intestinal discomforture, so diagnose 'em, dammit, and give 'em sumpthin' to make 'em better! Now leave me be.
column2: 嘿，這鎮上你才是藥劑師啊。俺們又沒什麼「戊醫師」，反正那些馬顯然是下消化道出了毛病，你就給俺診斷一下，該死的，弄點東西讓牠們好起來！現在別來煩俺了。

column1: Willy, you heard about the snail stampede?
column2: 威利，你聽說蝸牛暴動的事了嗎？

column1: Yepper.
column2: 聽說啦。

column1: Ever hear of anything like this happening?
column2: 你以前聽過這種事嗎？

column1: Nope, never.
column2: 沒，從來沒有。

column1: Well, what am I supposed to do about it?
column2: 那我到底該怎麼辦才好？

column1: Hey, boy, I'm jus' an ol' whittler, settin' around watching events unfold and commentin' with m'folksy, old-timey attitude... y'know, kinda cranky, but with a sense of humor, too.
column2: 嘿，小子，俺只是個削木頭的老頭，坐在這兒看世事變化，用俺這種鄉土老派的態度講講評論……你知道的，有點兇巴巴，但也挺幽默的。

column1: Can't you give me some advice?
column2: 你就不能給我點建議嗎？

column1: Welp, that ain't m' speciality, but I'll tell ya this: them snails ain't much different from your ordinary garden slugs. They prob'ly likes the same things. So jes' keep that in mind when dealin' with 'em.
column2: 嗯，那不是俺的專長啦，不過俺告訴你：那些蝸牛跟一般的花園蛞蝓沒差多少。牠們大概喜歡的東西也差不多。處理牠們的時候記得這一點就好。

column1: Yer welcome. Now get outta here, 'n go git some beer.
column2: 不客氣。現在快滾吧，去喝杯啤酒。

column1: Well, I got rid of those snails! Aren't you proud of me?
column2: 我把那些蝸牛都解決掉了！你是不是該為我感到驕傲啊？

column1: Yeah, yeah. Only it's gonna get a lot worse, I'm tellin' ya!
column2: 是啦，是啦。不過事情只會變得更糟，俺跟你講！

column1: How do you know?
column2: 你怎麼知道？

column1: Who's tellin' this story, you or me?
column2: 這故事是誰在講啊，你還是俺？

column1: Well, you, I guess...
column2: 呃，我猜是你吧……

column1: Then I guess I know whut I'm talkin' about, don't I? Now git on out to the desert and git that guy offa the anthill 'afore I pick you up and carry you there!
column2: 那俺講的東西應該就沒錯吧？現在快去沙漠，把那傢伙從蟻丘上弄下來，不然俺就親自把你扛過去！

column1: Alright, alright!
column2: 好啦，好啦！

column1: Willy, I got myself an assistant down at the Pharmacy.
column2: 威利，我在藥局那邊找了個助手。

column1: What'n the sam hill you need an assistant fer, kid? The Sheriff done closed your butt down!
column2: 你到底要助手幹嘛啊，小子？警長早就把你那間店給收了！

column1: Well, I've been so busy helping people and stuff, and I was hoping to reopen the store soon, so I thought...
column2: 呃，我最近一直在幫忙處理一些事情，而且我希望能快點重新開店，所以我想說……

column1: You thought, eh? Well, THAT'S a first! Anyhows, that assistant might come in handy eventually. But fer the time being, head on out to the outhouse and figger out whut's goin' ON out there! Seems like half the town's got the big-time runs!
column2: 你想說？哈，那還真是頭一遭！不管怎樣，那個助手總有一天可能派得上用場。不過現在，先去外面的茅房看看到底是怎麼回事！看樣子鎮上一半的人都拉肚子拉得挺厲害啊！

column1: The what?
column2: 什麼東西？

column1: I sez, |c2|GIT|c|!!
Hey, Willy!
column2: 嘿，威利！

column1: Leave me alone, I'm crabby.
column2: 別煩俺，俺心情不好。

column1: So what else is new? Listen, I'm gonna be leaving town for a while.
column2: 那有什麼新鮮的？聽好，我要離開鎮上一陣子。

column1: Yeah, right.
column2: 是喔，才怪。

column1: No, I am!
column2: 不，我是真的！

column1: Yew are not. Yer gonna practice yer gunslingin', then yer gonna dredge up that mucky ol' past of yours and go back to bein' a bigshot hero.
column2: 你才不是咧。你只是要去練練你的槍法，然後把你那段亂七八糟的過去挖出來，又跑去當什麼大英雄。

column1: Hey, half the Western Heros in America done the same thang. Good luck to ya. See ya in the dime novels. Now get a move on.
column2: 嘿，美國一半的西部英雄都幹過同樣的事。祝你好運。到時候廉價小說裡見。現在快去吧。

column1: Hiya, Whittlin' Willy!
column2: 嗨啊，削木威利！

column1: How'd the gunslingin' go?
column2: 練槍練得怎麼樣啊？

column1: Great! I'm getting ready to leave town now.
column2: 很好！我現在正準備要離開鎮上了。

column1: Drop the "leavin' town" bit, sonny. I know whut you're up to. This is my story, 'member?
column2: 別再演什麼「離開鎮上」那一套了，小子。俺知道你打的什麼算盤。這可是俺的故事，記得嗎？

column1: Oh, yeah.
column2: 喔，對喔。

column1: Now finish puttin' that disguise together and git to it, so's we kin git this town cleaned up once 'n fer all!
column2: 現在快把你的偽裝弄好，動手去做吧，咱們才能一勞永逸把這個鎮清乾淨！

column1: Hey, you don't have to tell me twice!
column2: 嘿，這種話你不用說第二遍！

column1: Don't be jostlin' my arm, son. You'll mess up my whittlin'!
column2: 別撞俺的手臂，小子。你會弄壞俺削的東西的！

column1: Sorry, son, that stuff's too strong fer me! But y'know, some moonshine'd go down real good right now!
column2: 抱歉啊，小子，那東西對俺來說太烈了！不過你也知道，現在來點私釀酒倒是挺不錯的！

column1: It's empty!
column2: 空的！

column1: Yeah.
column2: 對啊。

column1: Welp, bring it back when it's full, and we'll get stinkin'!
column2: 好啦，裝滿了再拿回來，咱們一起喝到掛！

column1: Hey! Smart thinkin', sonny! Didja get big points fer that?
column2: 嘿！腦筋動得快嘛，小子！那樣做有沒有加很多分啊？

column1: Pretty good, yeah.
column2: 還不錯，嗯。

column1: Well, all right then! Good goin'! Yew'll be a hero yet!
column2: 喔，那就成啦！幹得好！你早晚會變成英雄的！

column1: That stuff don't do me any good. M'hemorrhoids're too far gone for that pap. Little bit o' horse glue, though, an' I'm back in the saddle agin!
column2: 那玩意兒對俺沒啥用。俺的痔瘡都嚴重到那種糊藥膏救不回來了。倒是來點馬皮膠，俺立馬又能騎馬啦！

column1: I don't drink beer!
column2: 俺不喝啤酒的！

column1: Yew bin drinkin' the wrong beer, then. Yuh need a beer with the flavor that stays with yuh, beer after beer.
column2: 那你肯定喝錯啤酒啦。你得喝那種一杯接一杯，滋味還留在嘴裡的啤酒才行。

column1: Hey, I may LOOK like an old goat, but I don't eat like one!
column2: 嘿，俺看起來是像隻老山羊沒錯，可俺吃東西可不像山羊那樣亂啃！

column1: I cain't carve nuthin' with THAT! It ain't got a blade! 'Spoze I could poke holes in sumpthin' with it, but I don't really need to.
column2: 俺沒法用『那個』雕東西啦！它根本沒刀刃！頂多拿來戳幾個洞，可俺也用不著。

column1: That's whut ya calls yer charcoal, boy. Whut of it?
column2: 小子，那玩意兒你們叫木炭吧。怎麼了？

column1: I'm not sure why I've got it.
column2: 我也不知道自己怎麼會有這個。

column1: So what else is new, boy! You bin walkin' around, pickin' up everthing that ain't nailed down! You'll find a use for it eventually, I'm sure.
column2: 這有什麼稀奇的，小子！你成天到處亂晃，看到沒釘死的東西就往口袋塞！俺相信你遲早會找到它的用處。

column1: Don't whup me, boy! Don't whup me!
column2: 別揍俺啊，小子！別揍俺！

column1: No thanks, I hate eatin' charcoal outta a feed bag.
column2: 不用了，謝謝，俺最討厭從飼料袋裡挖木炭吃。

column1: It's a gas mask, not a feed bag.
column2: 這是防毒面具，不是飼料袋。

column1: Well, whutever it is, I don't need to be strappin' it on like some danged fool. You go ahead. It suits you better.
column2: 管它是什麼，俺才不要把那玩意兒往臉上綁，活像個大傻瓜。你自個兒留著吧，戴起來比較適合你。

column1: I don't need any of that pharmacy crap. I've got the constitution of an oxe. <wheeze> <hack> <cough>
column2: 俺才不需要那些藥局的破玩意兒。俺這身板壯得跟牛一樣。<喘><咳><咳嗽>

column1: Escargot sushi!
column2: 蝸牛壽司！

column1: What what?
column2: 什麼什麼？

column1: Never mind, kid. You'll learn whut it means in another 100 years or so. Now skedaddle!
column2: 算了，小鬼。再過個一百年左右你就懂那是啥意思了。快滾吧！

column1: You don't owe me nothin'. Take it away afore I change m'mind.
column2: 你什麼都不欠俺。趁俺還沒改變心意，快拿走吧。

column1: I dasn't drink beer, young 'un! How d'yall think I got to be this age?
column2: 俺可不敢喝啤酒，小娃兒！你以為俺是怎麼活到這把年紀的？

column1: I don't know, sir.
column2: 我不知道，先生。

column1: Well, it warn't by drinkin' that St. Louie pisswater. Make mine rotgut, every time!
column2: 反正不是靠喝那種聖路易尿水啤酒活下來的。俺每次都要喝烈酒才對味！

column1: They're empty, son!
column2: 它們是空的，小子！

column1: I know!
column2: 我知道！

column1: Well, whut'd you want me to do with 'em? Pee in 'em?
column2: 那你要俺拿它們幹嘛？尿在裡頭嗎？

column1: Maybe.
column2: 也許吧。

column1: Well, I went awhile ago. Thanks anyway!
column2: 呃，俺剛剛才上過。謝了！

column1: That ain't MY key, son! Yew just hang onto it.
column2: 那不是俺的鑰匙，小子！你自個兒留著吧。

column1: Nice piece o' lumber, kiddo. You wanted some stuff whittled into it? Take a number, I gotta finish this piece of scrimshaw.
column2: 不錯的木料嘛，小鬼。想要俺幫你雕點什麼？先排隊等著，俺得先把這件鯨骨雕刻品做完。

column1: Y'all got a hank of rope there! Yew bin garbage-pickin' down at Smithie's old place?
column2: 你手上那是一捆繩子嘛！你是不是跑去鐵匠史密的老地方翻垃圾啦？

column1: Glad to hear it. Now git.
column2: 聽你這麼說俺就放心了。快滾吧。

column1: Gotcherself a nice-lookin' lasso there. You tie it?
column2: 你那套索看起來挺不錯的嘛。是你自己打的結？

column1: Hmm. I'm gonna keep m'eye on you. You got the makin's of a real Western hero. Someday they'll be tellin' stories about you, mark my words. Now vamoose.
column2: 嗯。俺會盯著你的。你身上有真正西部英雄的料。總有一天大伙兒會傳頌你的故事，記住俺這句話。行了，快走吧。

column1: Whut do you think I am, stupid or sumpin'? I try and whittle that, I'll puncture it, and you'll get laughin' gas for blocks around! We'd all die laughin'! Not that it'd be a bad way to go, but hell, son, I got plans! There's tales to tell and wood t' whittle! Get outta here now.
column2: 你把俺當白痴還是怎樣？俺要是拿刀去雕那玩意兒，一戳破，方圓幾條街的人都要吸到笑氣！咱們全都會笑死！倒不是說那樣死法有多糟，可是啊，小子，俺可還有計畫哩！俺還有故事要講，還有木頭要雕呢！快從這兒滾出去。

column1: I sees ya got... whut, about a hunnerd sack?... of bakin' soda there, sonny.
column2: 俺看你手上拿的……那是啥，一百包小蘇打嗎？……小子。

column1: Yep, and it's feeling a little heavy, too.
column2: 沒錯，而且還挺重的。

column1: Shucks, son. I remembers when I wuz just a sprite in my mama's apple, I used to have to carry FIVE HUNNERD sack o' baking soda to school and back, ever' day, twenny-five miles in each direction. Yer jus' SPOILT, sonny, thet's what's wrong witcha! Now get back to whuch yer doin', and leave me to my whittlin'.
column2: 唉唷，小子。俺還記得自己還是俺娘蘋果裡那顆小精靈的時候，俺每天得扛五百包小蘇打上學又扛回家，來回各走二十五哩路呢。你就是被寵壞了，小子，你的毛病就出在這！好啦，回去做你該做的事，讓俺專心雕木頭。

column1: I don't look at no nekkid pitchers of wimmenfolk. But hey, ya got any pitchers of sheep? Bring 'em on by! Now git outta here.
column2: 俺才不看什麼女人的裸體照。不過話說回來，你有沒有綿羊的照片？有的話儘管拿來！好了，快滾出去吧。

column1: Nice bit o' wax ya gots there, sonny! Good fer lost-wax castin'! That reminds me, I wuz gonna finish whittlin' that pair o' skis. Welp, I'll get to it tomorrow.
column2: 你手上那塊蠟不錯嘛，小子！拿去做失蠟鑄造正合適！這倒提醒俺了，俺本來要把那雙滑雪板雕完的。唉，明天再說吧。

column1: You aim the gun at Willy... and pull the trigger!
column2: 你把槍瞄準威利……扣下扳機！

column1: HAH! My skin's tough as nails, kid. Like old rawhide. Bullets cain't stop me.
column2: 哈！俺這張皮硬得跟釘子一樣，小子。跟老牛皮似的。子彈打不倒俺。

column1: That shore does smell good, kid! Wouldn't mind whittlin' myself a slice o' that. Gives me the craps, though, so get it away from me.
column2: 聞起來還真香啊，小子！俺是不介意切一片來嚐嚐，不過那東西會害俺拉肚子，還是拿遠一點吧。

column1: I don't drink thet stuff. Eats m'gullet out. Gives me ulcers. But you run across some Everclear, I'm right there besides ya.
column2: 俺不喝那玩意兒。會把俺的喉嚨燒穿，還會讓俺長潰瘍。不過你要是弄到純穀烈酒，俺立馬站你這邊。

column1: Keepin' yer pistols polished, son. Thet's what it's all about.
column2: 把你的手槍擦亮點，小子。這才是重點。

column1: Hey, them's some nice, shiny new bullets ya got! Won't do ya much good settin' in yer sweaty palm, though. Load 'em or lose 'em, kid!
column2: 嘿，你那些子彈又新又亮嘛！不過擱在你那汗兮兮的手心裡也沒什麼用。要嘛裝進槍裡，要嘛就丟了吧，小子！

column1: That there's clay! You lookin' to do some lost-wax castin'?
column2: 那是黏土嘛！你是想做失蠟鑄造嗎？

column1: Some what?
column2: 什麼鑄造？

column1: Never mind, it'd take too long to explain to ya.
column2: 算了，跟你解釋起來太花時間了。

column1: That's a fine bit o' silver, kiddo, the kinda thing you could molten' down and use fer lost-wax castin', if you were a mind to! Thet reminds me, gotter get to Sal's one of these days to have muh false teeth re-silvered.
column2: 那是塊上好的銀子啊，小鬼，要是你有心的話，融了就能拿去做失蠟鑄造！這倒提醒俺，俺該找個時間去阿薩那兒把俺的假牙重新鍍銀。

column1: Nice duds ya got there, whippersnapper! Beige 'n turquoise. Reminds me a fella I knew, openin' up a restaurant by the Eastern Pacific line. Howie Johnson, I think his name wuz. Loved beige 'n turquoise.
column2: 你這身行頭挺不賴嘛，小毛頭！米色配土耳其藍。讓俺想起俺認識的一個傢伙，在東太平洋鐵路線旁開了間餐廳。俺記得他叫豪伊強森，最愛米色配土耳其藍了。

column1: Go with bright orange, I says to him, "Beige is sich a prissy li'l color." "But it goes with everything," he says to me. "Whut if it does?" I says. "Folks'll remember orange and turquoise. Nobody remembers beige and turquoise."
column2: 「用鮮橘色啦，」俺跟他說，「米色那種顏色太娘娘腔了。」「可是它跟什麼都搭啊，」他跟俺說。「搭又怎樣？」俺說。「大伙兒會記得橘配藍綠，沒人會記得米色配藍綠的。」

column1: I don't know if he ever listened to me. Oh, well. Anyways, nice duds. Next time, ya might think about goin' with orange instead of beige.
column2: 俺也不知道他到底有沒有聽進去。唉，算了。總之，行頭不錯。下次啊，你可以考慮穿橘色，別再穿米色了。

column1: Oh, yeah! That thang! It'll be ready Tuesday! Ha ha ha, that's a thigh-slapper, son! Shoot, I wuz jus' funnin' ya. I dunno what that's fer.
column2: 喔，對！那玩意兒！星期二就會弄好啦！哈哈哈，這笑話夠冷吧，小子！得了，俺就是逗你玩的。俺根本不知道那是幹嘛用的。

column1: Nice pair o' sissified boots ya gots there, kid! Ain't nuttin' like a li'l turquoise 'n beige to strike fear inter the hearts of men!
column2: 你那雙靴子挺娘的嘛，小子！沒什麼比一點土耳其藍配米色更能讓大男人聞風喪膽的了！

column1: Cain't whittle nothin' outta THAT, kid!
column2: 那玩意兒俺可雕不出啥東西來，小子！

column1: I cain't read this. I ain't got muh readin' glasses on.
column2: 俺看不懂這個。俺沒戴老花眼鏡。

column1: Hey, that ain't yourn! That belongs down t' the cemetery, don't it?
column2: 嘿，那不是你的東西！那應該是墓園裡的吧，不是嗎？

column1: I was just borrowing it for a while.
column2: 我只是先借用一下而已。

column1: Oh, yeah, right. An' Mrs. Lincoln enjoyed the show. Git lost, yew shovel-stealin' varmint.
column2: 喔，是喔，對啦。林肯夫人那晚也看戲看得挺盡興的呢。滾遠一點，你這個偷鏟子的小賊。

column1: What the HELL you want me to do with THIS thing?
column2: 你到底要俺拿這東西幹什麼鬼用啊？

column1: Nothing, I guess.
column2: 我想……沒事吧。

column1: Good! It smells like horse poop, only it don't weigh nuthin'! Whut is it, "Horse Poop Lite" or somethin'? Get it outta my face!
column2: 很好！這玩意兒聞起來像馬糞，可是又不會很重！是什麼，「輕盈馬糞」嗎？快從俺眼前拿走！

column1: If you didn't want it, why'd you take it?
column2: 你要是不想要，幹嘛拿它？

column1: Whut'd you want me to do with THIS? Whittle it into sumpthin'? It's too soft! Bring it back in a couple weeks, when it's toughened up a little.
column2: 你要俺拿『這個』幹嘛？雕成什麼東西嗎？這太軟了！過個幾星期，它硬一點再拿回來吧。

column1: Potatoe sackse.
column2: 馬鈴暑麻布袋。

column1: They'r note fore sal.
column2: 它們不事要賣滴。

column1: These are big ol' crates of the newest taste sensation sweeping the East. Too bad it hasn't reached the West Coast yet, hence all these full boxes.
column2: 這些是一箱箱風靡東岸的最新口味零食。可惜還沒傳到西岸來，所以這些箱子才會全部堆在這兒沒賣掉。

column1: Due to a recent scandal, Chester refuses to sell any more Broccoli Roll-ups.
column2: 因為最近鬧出的醜聞，切斯特再也不肯賣花椰菜捲了。

column1: Barrels of Chester Field's most famous smoked delicacies.
column2: 一桶桶切斯特最有名的煙燻美食。

column1: Chester isn't selling any more smoked pickles. He's recently developed a major craving for them, and goes through about a barrel a week.
column2: 切斯特已經不賣煙燻醃黃瓜了。他最近迷上這味，一星期就能自己吃掉一整桶。

column1: Sacks of Bachelor's Favourite Flour.
column2: 一袋袋單身漢最愛麵粉。

column1: Pressure from local conservatives convinced Chester to stop selling these to unmarried persons. They felt he was promoting premarital sacks!
column2: 在地保守人士施壓，讓切斯特不再賣給未婚人士。他們覺得這是在鼓吹『婚前偷嘗禁袋』！

column1: It's a horseshoe from Chester's old swayback horse, that got spooked by a wagon, ran into the street and broke its leg under the wagon wheel. Chester sent it to a veterinarian in San Francisco at outrageous cost, but in the end, the horse died anyway. Took every penny Chester had, since the horsemeat guy wouldn't buy the carcass.
column2: 這是切斯特那匹老馬掉下來的馬蹄鐵，那匹背都塌了的老馬被馬車嚇到，衝到街上被輪子輾斷了腿。切斯特花了大把銀子把牠送去舊金山看獸醫，結果那匹馬最後還是死了。花光了切斯特所有的積蓄，因為連收馬肉的人都不肯買下那具屍體。

column1: Guess he keeps the horseshoe up there for good luck.
column2: 看樣子他是把馬蹄鐵掛在那兒討個吉利。

column1: What? And take away Chester's good luck charm?
column2: 什麼？把切斯特的幸運符拿走？

column1: Better not touch it. Whoever this Kay Graham is, she might be very upset.
column2: 還是別碰的好。不管這位「凱·葛拉漢」是誰，她搞不好會很不高興。

column1: A small metal mirror.
column2: 一面小小的金屬鏡子。

column1: It's nailed in place. Apparently Chester wants to keep it.
column2: 它被釘死在那兒了。看樣子切斯特想留著它。

column1: These industrial-strength heavy-duty cast-lead pans are coated with a mercury-chlorine compound in order to make them stick-resistant.
column2: 這些工業級重型鑄鉛鍋，表面鍍了一層汞氯化合物，號稱不沾鍋。

column1: Even though they're still hanging up, Chester yanked 'em off the market when it was discovered that lead, mercury and chlorine are all toxic. The manufacturer denies any responsibility.
column2: 雖然這些鍋子還掛在架上，但自從被發現鉛、汞、氯都有毒之後，切斯特就把它們全部下架了。製造商否認一切責任。

column1: This is an old kerosene lantern.
column2: 這是一盞老舊的煤油燈。

column1: Chester only sells lanterns in combination with kerosene, but there's no kerosene to be found these days.
column2: 切斯特只賣搭配煤油的燈，可是這年頭根本找不到煤油。

column1: SevereWare Non-Clad Kettles.
column2: 「嚴重牌」無包層水壺。

column1: Chester's playing it safe; he won't sell these until he's determined that there's no lead, mercury, or chlorine in their manufacture.
column2: 切斯特這次學乖了，除非確定製造過程裡沒有鉛、汞或氯，否則他不會賣這些。

column1: This old milk pitcher was only slightly used out on the farm.
column2: 這個舊牛奶壺在農場裡只用過幾次而已。

column1: Federal law prohibits the sale of items that once contained unpasteurized milk.
column2: 聯邦法律禁止販售曾裝過未經高溫消毒牛奶的容器。

column1: A hank of rope.
column2: 一捆繩子。

column1: It's already been sold; Chester's just waiting for Hank to pick it up.
column2: 這個已經賣掉了，切斯特只是在等漢克來取貨。

column1: Assorted-size buckets... chicken, grease, slaw, taters and brown gravy-like paste not included.
column2: 各種尺寸的桶子……不含雞肉、油脂、涼拌菜絲、馬鈴薯和類似棕色肉汁的醬料。

column1: Chester stopped selling these after they levied the state-wide New Bucket Tax.
column2: 自從州政府開徵『新桶子稅』之後，切斯特就不賣這些了。

column1: This is the interior of Chester Field's Mercantile Company. He used to call it a "General Store" until he ran out of Generals.
column2: 這裡是切斯特雜貨公司的內部。他以前把這裡叫做「將軍雜貨店」，直到將軍都用完了為止。

column1: Most of what's here won't talk to you, unless it has vocal cords.
column2: 這裡大部分的東西都不會跟你說話，除非它長了聲帶。

column1: The building's not for sale. It's Chester Field's livelihood!
column2: 這棟房子不賣。這可是切斯特安身立命的本錢！

column1: It's a nice picture of a pussycat laying on its back.
column2: 這是一張仰躺著的貓咪照片，挺可愛的。

column1: You won't need any Kitty Porn in this game!
column2: 這款遊戲用不著什麼貓咪養眼照！

column1: It's an Early American Bug Zapper. It's a scented candle with Bits O' Gunpowder melted into it.
column2: 這是一款早期美式驅蟲器。其實就是一根融了火藥碎粒的香氛蠟燭。

column1: It's not for sale. Chester likes to keep his store bug-free.
column2: 這不賣。切斯特喜歡讓店裡保持無蟲狀態。

column1: It's a hanging broom. The nineteenth-century equivalent of an "air cleaner."
column2: 這是一把懸掛的掃帚，算是十九世紀版的「空氣清淨機」。

column1: It's out of reach. Chester puts everything up there that he really kinda wants to hang onto.
column2: 這東西你搆不到。切斯特把真正想留著的東西都放在那上頭。

column1: A hanging kerosene lantern, used to provide light in the store at night. Since there's no more kerosene to be found, though, Chester now closes at night.
column2: 一盞懸掛的煤油燈，原本用來在夜間為店裡照明。可是現在找不到煤油了，切斯特只好晚上關店。

column1: Take the lantern? But... but... but... but that would be STEALING!
column2: 拿走這盞燈？可、可、可、可是那樣就是偷竊了啊！
