column1: Don't poke him right now, he's concentrating on losing everything. And he's doing very well!
column2: 現在別戳他，他正專心致志地在輸光一切，而且輸得相當出色！

column1: Don't bother giving that to Muff. He'll just gamble it away.
column2: 別費事把那個給莫夫了，他只會拿去賭光。

column1: You'd shoot poor ol' Muff? Shame, shame!
column2: 你要對可憐的老馬夫開槍？羞羞臉，羞羞臉！

column1: That's Joe, the guy that had a bad time with ol' Muff Potter a few years back. He owns a local tourist trap. And "trap" it is! He trapped a couple of punks in there a few years back, Tom and Becky something or other. They almost didn't get out. Somebody oughtta write a book about it!
column2: 那是喬，幾年前跟老莫夫·波特結過梁子的傢伙。他經營一個本地的觀光「陷阱」，而且還真是名副其實的陷阱！幾年前他把兩個小屁孩──湯姆跟貝琪什麼的──困在裡頭，他們差點就出不來了。真該有人把這事寫成一本書！

column1: You're gambling the Tourist Center away? Say it ain't so, Joe!
column2: 你要把觀光中心也賭掉？別跟我說是真的，喬！

column1: Joe grunts. That's the most you've ever heard him say!
column2: 喬哼了一聲。這是你聽過他說過最長的話了！

column1: Don't poke this guy. He's mean.
column2: 別戳這傢伙，他很兇。

column1: Joe is far too proud and noble to take what you have to give him. He'd rather steal it!
column2: 喬太驕傲、太高尚了，不屑接受你給的東西，他寧可自己偷！

column1: You can't shoot a man for gambling! Well, maybe in SOME states.
column2: 你不能因為人家賭博就開槍打他！嗯，某些州或許可以吧。

column1: Three mean-looking hombres sit up close to the stage. Upon closer examination, you see that they're drinking wine spritzers. Maybe they're not so mean after all.
column2: 三個長相兇惡的漢子坐在靠近舞台的地方。仔細一看，你發現他們喝的是氣泡調酒。看來他們也許沒那麼兇。

column1: Welcome to Coarsegold, strangers! I haven't seen you around these parts before. You new in town?
column2: 歡迎來到粗金鎮，陌生人！我以前沒在這一帶見過你們，是剛搬來的嗎？

column1: You hear the unmistakable sound of grinding and cracking teeth. You hear the splitting, tearing sound of six severely chapped lips curling up in ugly sneers. You hear the pop of knuckles as three trigger fingers flex in readiness. You decide your friendly, offhand comments have been misinterpreted.
column2: 你聽見一陣咬牙切齒的聲音，錯不了。你聽見六片乾裂的嘴唇扭曲成醜陋冷笑時撕裂的聲音。你聽見三根扣板機的手指擺出備戰姿勢時關節喀喀作響。你判斷，自己那句隨口的友善話似乎被誤會了。

column1: You don't want to touch these hombres. They don't look like they're into close physical contact.
column2: 你可不想去碰這些漢子。他們看起來不太喜歡跟人有親密接觸。

column1: They don't want it.
column2: 他們不想要。

column1: As you cock the hammers back on your pistols... you suddenly hear a whole CHORUS of pistols make the same sound. You gently ease the hammer forward, slowly, without making any sudden moves. Smart boy.
column2: 就在你扳起手槍擊錘的瞬間……你突然聽見一整片槍械擊錘同時響起的聲音，簡直像大合唱。你慢慢地、輕輕地把擊錘放回去，動作不敢有半點突然。算你聰明。

column1: Without warning, you hear gunshots out in front of the Saloon, plus lots of yelling and shouting. What's going on out there?
column2: 毫無預警地，你聽見酒館外傳來槍聲，還有大量的叫喊聲。外頭到底發生了什麼事？

column1: The Ballad of the Frontier Pharmacist
column2: 邊疆藥師之歌

column1: Revolucion Numero 9
column2: 第九號革命

column1: I've Grown Accustomed to Your Ace
column2: 我已經習慣了你的王牌

column1: Hot Lead in the Old Town Tonight
column2: 今夜古鎮熱鉛橫飛

column1: The Varmint of Baghdad
column2: 巴格達的害獸

column1: Gunrise, Gunset
column2: 槍起槍落

column1: When You Say Blood
column2: 當你說出血

column1: Zircon Jim's Theme
column2: 鋯石吉姆主題曲

column1: Singh Sungh Blue
column2: 辛桑藍調

column1: My Sweet Cranky Ol' Mom
column2: 我那暴躁的老媽甜心

column1: Play it, Neville. Play...
column2: 彈吧，內維爾。彈啊……

column1: Rewind
column2: 倒帶

column1: Rewind-O-Matic
column2: 自動倒帶機

column1: Be Kind! Please Rewind!
column2: 做人厚道點！看完請倒帶！

column1: The brass rail runs along the length of the bar.
column2: 黃銅扶杆沿著吧檯全長延伸。

column1: But you don't know where that bar rail has been!
column2: 但你不知道那根扶杆到底沾過什麼東西！

column1: Hey, you wouldn't want to do me a little favor, would you? Kinda distract Aces so's I can get a shot off?
column2: 嘿，你該不會願意幫我個小忙吧？稍微引開王牌的注意，好讓我開一槍？

column1: What's in it for me?
column2: 那我能得到什麼好處？

column1: Nice 'tude.
column2: 態度真好啊。

column1: You can't reach him now. Throttle him later, once you've settled with Aces.
column2: 你現在搆不到他。等你跟王牌了結之後，再回來掐他吧。

column1: Goodness, the Saloon sure filled up fast! Practically the whole town's gathered round to see you die a bloody death... I mean, to see you bring Aces to justice!
column2: 天哪，這酒館一下子擠滿人了！幾乎全鎮的人都聚過來看你血淋淋地死……我是說，看你把王牌繩之以法！

column1: Don't ask the townies for help, Freddy. The ball's in your court.
column2: 別指望鎮民幫忙了，佛萊迪。球在你手上。

column1: There's nothing you can reach from your strategically rotten position behind the overturned table.
column2: 躲在這張翻倒的桌子後面，這個「絕佳」的爛位置，你什麼也搆不到。

column1: Wheaton "Aces" Hall, the infamous riverboat gambler, seems to have you under a barrel!
column2: 看來把你困在木桶陰影下，任他擺佈了！

column1: Give yourself up, Aces! I caught you red-handed!
column2: 束手就擒吧，王牌！我當場抓到你了！

column1: (GEORGE BUSH) Never! Not gonna do it. Nope. Wouldn't be prudent at this juncture.
column2: （喬治布希腔）不！休想。不可能。這個節骨眼上這麼做並不明智。

column1: But I caught you!
column2: 可是我抓到你了！

column1: Yes, but I ain't goin' nowhere if I can help it! And I warn you, if you shoot me in cold blood, you'll HANG!
column2: 沒錯，但只要我還能反抗，我哪兒也不會去！我警告你，你要是冷血地開槍打我，你會被吊死的！

column1: Drop your gun and give up! You can't win!
column2: 放下槍投降吧！你贏不了的！

column1: Considering you're the one cowering behind a table, don't you think YOU should be the one giving up?
column2: 想想看，躲在桌子後面發抖的人是你，你不覺得該投降的人是「你」嗎？

column1: I'm not cowering!
column2: 我才沒有發抖！

column1: Could've fooled me.
column2: 你可騙不了我。

column1: I'm going to count to three, and when I reach three, you'd better have your hands in the air!
column2: 我要數到三，數到三的時候，你最好把雙手舉起來！

column1: Oh, my, I'm a-scared.
column2: 唉呀，我好怕怕喔。

column1: ONE!
column2: 一！

column1: You realize, I hope, that the moment you show your head or any part of your body around that table, I'll shoot you dead. You DO know that, don't you?
column2: 我希望你明白，只要你把頭或身體任何一部分露出桌子外面，我就會一槍斃了你。你懂這一點，對吧？

column1: TWO!
column2: 二！

column1: It's no shirt off MY back, of course. The Sheriff'll never arrest ME for murder. We're both on the same team, ya know.
column2: 反正這對我一點損失也沒有。警長絕不會以謀殺罪逮捕我，畢竟我們是同一國的，你懂的。

column1: TWO-AND-A-HALF!
column2: 二點五！

column1: Just let me shoot you now. This is embarassing.
column2: 讓我現在就開槍打死你吧，這樣拖下去太丟臉了。

column1: TWO-AND-SEVEN- EIGHTHS!
column2: 二又八分之七！

column1: Not to mention tedious.
column2: 更別提有多無聊了。

column1: Okay, apparently you didn't understand me. I'll start over.
column2: 好吧，看來你沒聽懂，我重新來一次。

column1: Touch me and you'll get a bullet in the heart before you know it.
column2: 敢碰我，你連反應都來不及就會中彈穿心。

column1: Geez! Talk about homophobia!
column2: 天啊！這也太恐同了吧！

column1: Ah'm gonna have to arrest yew for attempted murder, stranger. You shouldna' oughtta shot at him in cold blood like that. Gamblin', I kin overlook; really suspicious accidents, I kin overlook; unfortunate co-inky-dinces, I kin overlook. But you shot this boy straight out, son. Hate to hear whut th' Judge is gonna have to say about this! Why, yer gonna HANG, boy!
column2: 俺得以殺人未遂的罪名逮捕你了，陌生人。你不該那樣冷血地朝他開槍。賭博嘛，俺可以睜隻眼閉隻眼；真的很可疑的意外，俺也能睜隻眼閉隻眼；倒楣的巧合，俺照樣睜隻眼閉隻眼。但你這回是明目張膽開槍打這小子，孩子。真不想聽法官會怎麼說這事！哎呀，你這下要「上吊」啦，孩子！

column1: He did it! What a MANLY man! Riverboat gambler in the corner pocket!
column2: 他還真做到了！好一個有男子氣概的男人！賭船老千，一桿進袋！

column1: Yee-hawwww!
column2: 呀呼∼！

column1: I could have done that if I'd wanted to. I just didn't feel like it, that's all.
column2: 我要做的話早就做了，只是懶得做而已，就這樣。

column1: Now, when the townsfolk caught wind o' how Aces'd been cheatin', the Sheriff had no choice but to arrest him and return all the deeds. But wouldn' ya know, no sooner had one brouhaha died down than anuther flared up...
column2: 話說鎮民風聞王牌耍老千的消息，警長不得不將他逮捕，把所有地契都物歸原主。誰曉得，一場風波才剛平息，另一場又起了頭…

column1: A brass rail runs along the length of the bar. This is a decorative, if uncomfortable, place for the drunks to rest their heads. It must be made of very hard metal as it has withstood the test of heels for many years.
column2: 一根黃銅欄杆沿著吧台延伸。這是個裝飾用、卻不怎麼舒服的地方，供醉漢趴著休息。它一定是用很硬的金屬打造的，畢竟多年來禁得起鞋跟的摧殘。

column1: Aces' is holding his cards tightly. One of his hands appears unusually stiff. Maybe he's nervous?
column2: 王牌把牌握得死緊。他有隻手看起來異常僵硬，難道是緊張了？

column1: Don't touch my cards, Silver Boy. You wouldn't want to be accused of CHEATING, would you?
column2: 別碰我的牌，銀耳小子。你該不會想被人說是在作弊吧？

column1: Despite his slimy demeanor and underhanded undertaking, you can't bring yourself to shoot him point-blank. You'll have to find a better way.
column2: 儘管他油腔滑調、行事卑鄙，你還是下不了手當場斃了他。你得想個更好的辦法。

column1: It appears to be a third hand! So THAT'S how Aces is cheating!
column2: 這看起來是第三隻手！原來王牌就是這樣作弊的！

column1: Wheaton "Aces" Hall, slick big-time, back-East, riverboat gambler, has turned the saloon's friendly poker game into vicious high-stakes gambling, winning money, land, buildings, and businesses from the local bumpkins.
column2: 惠頓「王牌」霍爾，一個從東岸來的油滑大牌賭船老千，把酒館裡友善的撲克局變成了兇狠的高額賭局，從當地土包子手裡贏走了錢財、土地、房產與生意。

column1: Scoot along, Silver Boy, before I deal you the Dead Man's Hand.
column2: 快滾吧，銀耳小子，免得我發給你一手死人牌。

column1: Quit prodding me, stranger. I'll finish with you later.
column2: 別再戳我了，陌生人。等會兒再跟你算帳。

column1: Take it away. Can't you see I'm busy?
column2: 拿走拿走。你沒看到我正忙著嗎？

column1: I can see you're up to no good! And I can see you're holding three of a kind, Kings, and the rest of your hand is garbage.
column2: 我看得出你不懷好意！我還看得出你手裡有三條老K，剩下的牌全是垃圾。

column1: Shut up! Don't listen to him, boys, he's just trying to rattle ya.
column2: 閉嘴！別聽他的，各位，他只是想擾亂你們的心。

column1: Aces is clearly winning by a mile. He's piled up a lot of chips, in addition to a pocketful of property deeds!
column2: 王牌顯然贏得遙遙領先。他堆了一大疊籌碼，口袋裡還塞滿了地契！

column1: Hands off that! It's mine, I won it, fair and square!
column2: 手拿開！那是我的，我光明正大贏來的！

column1: Are you sure about that?
column2: 你確定嗎？

column1: Am I sure? Am I SURE? I'm the most honest gambler in this town!
column2: 我確定？我確定？我可是這鎮上最誠實的賭徒！

column1: (SARCASTICALLY) Oh, like THAT'S saying much!
column2: （諷刺地）喔，那還真是了不起呢！

column1: Ollie's money is dwindling rapidly.
column2: 奧利的錢正快速縮水。

column1: Don't take Ollie's money, he needs all he can get right now.
column2: 別拿走奧利的錢，他現在能省一分是一分。

column1: Coarsegold has really gone to pot now!
column2: 粗金鎮這下真是徹底完了！

column1: Hey, hey, hey. Nobody at this table's gonna take kindly to you walking off with the chips.
column2: 嘿，嘿，嘿。這桌上沒人會樂見你捧著籌碼走人。

column1: That's old Ollie Oxenfree, up close and personal! He's the guy who owns the fig farms on the northern side of Collier Bluff. He's the worst gambler in town! He'll lose the entire North 40 in no time!
column2: 那是老奧利·奧克斯弗里，近距離讓你瞧個仔細！他就是柯里爾崖北邊那片無花果農場的主人。他是全鎮最爛的賭徒！用不了多久他就會把北邊那四十畝地全輸光！

column1: Don't waste your breath. Ollie needs what little concentration he has just to hang onto his farm a few minutes more.
column2: 省點力氣吧。歐利那點僅存的專注力，全用來多守住他的農場幾分鐘了。

column1: Gambling away his Keg 'n Barrel shop is Cooper "Coop" Cooper. He, his wife, his children and his parents all work in his barrel shop. He's a cooper, she's a cooper, they're all coopers. (Wouldn't you like to be a cooper too?)
column2: 正在把「木桶酒窖」店輸光的是庫柏「箍桶匠」庫柏。他、他老婆、他的孩子、還有他爸媽，全都在他的木桶店裡幹活。他是箍桶匠，她也是箍桶匠，全家都是箍桶匠。（你是不是也想當個箍桶匠呢？）

column1: Cooper, please! You can't lose everything, you just can't!
column2: 庫柏，拜託！你不能輸光一切，真的不能！

column1: He doesn't speak, but his attitude is clearly, "Oh, yeah? Just watch me!"
column2: 他一句話也沒說，但態度分明是：「是嗎？你就瞧好了！」

column1: Don't bother him now; he's trying to recoop!
column2: 現在別煩他；他正想把老本「箍」回來呢！

column1: That's Muff Potter. Nice to see him and Joe getting along again! He owns -- or at least, he DID own until he started playing -- a huge tract of land along the south side of town, where Chinatown used to be.
column2: 那是馬夫·波特。真高興看到他跟喬又和好了！他名下有——至少在他開始賭之前是有——鎮南一大片地，那裡以前是唐人街。

column1: Muff nods his head in agreement, and keeps playing. Muff's never been too bright.
column2: 馬夫點頭表示同意，繼續賭他的牌。馬夫向來不太聰明。

column1: Don't poke him right now, he's concentrating on losing everything. And doing a damn good job of it, too!
column2: 現在別戳他，他正專心致志地輸光一切。而且輸得相當漂亮！

column1: That's Joe, the guy that had a bad time with ol' Muff Potter a few years back. He owns a local tourist trap that really is a "trap." He trapped a couple of punks in there a few years back, Tom and Becky somebody or other. They almost didn't get out. Somebody ought to write a book about it!
column2: 那是喬，幾年前跟老馬夫·波特結過樑子的傢伙。他擁有本地一個名副其實的「陷阱」觀光景點。幾年前他把兩個小鬼——好像叫湯姆跟貝琪什麼的——困在裡頭。他們差點沒能出來。真該有人把這事寫成書才對！

column1: Joe grunts. And that's the most you've ever heard him say!
column2: 喬哼了一聲。這已經是你聽過他講最多話的一次了！

column1: You've got to think of a way to frame Aces!
column2: 你得想個辦法把王牌給栽贓下獄！

column1: Leave the frame right where it is. It's doing such a good job of adding to the composition of the image.
column2: 畫框就留在原地吧。它可為這幅畫的構圖加分不少呢。

column1: Aces is even uglier close-up than he is from afar! Maybe it would help if you squinted.
column2: 王牌近看比遠看還醜！也許瞇著眼看會好一點。

column1: Shhhh, it's rude to talk to that while the game's in progress.
column2: 噓，牌局進行中跟那個講話很沒禮貌。

column1: Get that finger away from me. You're making me nervous. And I don't LIKE people that make me nervous.
column2: 把你的手指從我身上拿開。你讓我很緊張。我可不喜歡讓我緊張的人。

column1: This is the poker table. Most of the value of Coarsegold seems to be going from this side to Aces' side.
column2: 這是撲克牌桌。粗金鎮大部分的財富，似乎都從這一邊流向了王牌那一邊。

column1: Hey, keep your hands off the table. And don't make me tell you again.
column2: 嘿，手離桌子遠一點。別讓我再說第二次。

column1: You're cheating! That's a fake left hand! Your real hand is hidden under the table! You've been feeding good cards into your hand and taking away the bad ones!
column2: 你在作弊！那是隻假的左手！你的真手藏在桌子底下！你一直把好牌塞進手裡，再把爛牌抽掉！

column1: Why, yes, silver-eared stranger! You're correct... almost! As you see, I have no cards under the table. I only have this...
column2: 哎呀，沒錯，銀耳陌生人！你說對了…差不多啦！你看，我桌底下沒有牌。我只有這個…

column1: Now turn around, silver-ear! I think I'd rather shoot you in the back, so I don't have see that ugly face of yours!
column2: 現在轉過身去，銀耳仔！我想我寧可從背後斃了你，這樣就不必看你那張醜臉了！

column1: Sitting behind the counter is P.H. Balance, current owner and operator of The Bank of Bob.
column2: 坐在櫃台後面的是P·H·貝倫斯，鮑伯銀行現任的老闆兼經營者。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) He's a bore and a lice-infested jerk.
column2: （低聲嘀咕）他是個無聊透頂、渾身長蝨子的混蛋。

column1: Come again? Did you say something, Pharkas?
column2: 你說什麼？你剛剛說了什麼嗎，法卡斯？

column1: I said you were more than just a nice, respected clerk!
column2: 我是說你不只是位親切受人尊敬的行員！

column1: Oh. That's very different.
column2: 喔，那可差多了。

column1: Have I told you about our new Columbus Day account? It's a full benefit, non-interest -bearing account.
column2: 我跟你提過我們新推出的哥倫布日帳戶了嗎？這是個福利全開、但完全不計利息的帳戶。

column1: Did you hear about our Easter Club account? We may even make it an interest-bearing account if we can bear to part with the interest!
column2: 你聽說我們的復活節俱樂部帳戶了嗎？要是我們捨得把利息分出去，說不定還會讓它變成計息帳戶呢！

column1: Yessir, our latest Halloween passbook account is very innovative! We give you zero percent interest and only charge you a nominal fee.
column2: 是的，我們最新的萬聖節存摺帳戶非常創新！我們給你零利率，只酌收一點點名義上的手續費。

column1: We have a new Yom Kippur savings account. Irving over at the deli in Bass Lake just opened one up. I'm sure he'd recommend it.
column2: 我們有個新的贖罪日儲蓄帳戶。貝斯湖那家熟食店的爾文才剛開了一個，我相信他會推薦的。

column1: You know, this is the last day to be eligible for our interest-free Secretary's Day checking account. It's only $27.00 per month and we bill your secretary!
column2: 跟你說，今天是申請我們無息秘書節支票帳戶的最後一天。每個月只要27美元，我們會把帳單寄給你的秘書！

column1: Soon it'll be time for the Saint Patrick's Day promotion. We give you the account and you give us the green!
column2: 聖派翠克節的促銷活動就快到了。我們給你帳戶，你給我們綠鈔票！

column1: Tomorrow's my birthday. Leave me a present and I'll open you a P.H. Balance Birthday Club account!
column2: 明天是我生日。留份禮物給我，我就幫你開一個P·H·貝倫斯生日俱樂部帳戶！

column1: For Memorial Day, we're letting you remember us by taking your money and hiding it in our vault.
column2: 陣亡將士紀念日，我們讓你永誌不忘的方式，就是把你的錢拿走藏進我們的金庫。

column1: Say, it was too bad about your Pharmacy being shut down. Must be hard to lose a business so sudden like. We here at the Bank of Bob sympathize.
column2: 說起來，你藥局關門真是太可惜了。生意這麼突然沒了，一定不好受。我們鮑伯銀行深表同情。

column1: Yeah, I'm sorry about your pharmacy. Maybe you should think about selling up and leaving town.
column2: 是啊，你藥局的事我很遺憾。也許你該考慮把店賣了，離開這個鎮子。

column1: Well, I know you can't be coming in to make a deposit here at the Bank of Bob. No business, no money, right? Might as well be selling the old place.
column2: 嗯，我知道你不是來鮑伯銀行存款的。沒生意，沒錢，對吧？乾脆把老店賣了算了。

column1: You know, it would be a shame if the Bank of Bob had to foreclose on your Pharmacy. Maybe you could sell it before things get that bad. I might be able to suggest an investor.
column2: 跟你說，要是鮑伯銀行不得不查封你的藥局，那就太可惜了。也許你可以趁事情惡化前先把它賣了。我或許能幫你介紹個投資人。

column1: How about it, Freddy? Thought any more about selling that run-down store of yours?
column2: 怎麼樣啊，佛萊迪？那間破舊的店，考慮得怎麼樣了，要不要賣？

column1: You better be selling, Pharkas. Life in the West can get downright dangerous for people who can't pay their way. I could take that place off your hands. Of course, I'd offer a fair market value. Not that that's much with the market the way it is. But the Bank of Bob wants to be fair.
column2: 你最好賣了它，法卡斯。在這西部，付不出錢的人日子可不好過。我可以幫你把那地方接手過去。當然，我會出個合理的市價。雖然照現在的行情，那也值不了多少錢。但鮑伯銀行講求公道。

column1: Come to sell me your store yet?
column2: 考慮好要把店賣給我了嗎？

column1: I don't do business with losers. And you're about to lose, Pharkas. Big time.
column2: 我不跟輸家做生意。而你就快要輸了，法卡斯。輸得徹底。

column1: Please keep your grubby hands to yourself.
column2: 請把你那雙髒手管好。

column1: (SOTTO VOCE) |c1|Yeah, how would you like me to turn your butt in to the ol' IRS, you goat!|c|
column2: （壓低聲音） |c1|哼，你這老山羊，要不要我把你的屁股舉報給國稅局啊！|c|

column1: Did you say something?
column2: 你說了什麼嗎？

column1: I said, "How I would love a turn at buttoning your Old Squire's blue coat."
column2: 我是說，「真希望有機會替您那件老紳士藍外套扣扣子。」

column1: Oh. Thank you, I'll button it myself.
column2: 喔，謝了，我自己扣就行。

column1: Don't try to sell me any of that bilge water, Pharkas. It's chicanery, pure and simple.
column2: 別想把那種污水賣給我，法卡斯。這根本就是純粹的騙術。

column1: This is privileged information. I shouldn't even be looking at this. Trust you to fly in the face of propriety, Pharkas.
column2: 這是機密資料。我根本不該看這個。也就只有你會這樣公然藐視規矩，法卡斯。

column1: Take that nasty little glass away from me. It's stinking up my class establishment.
column2: 把那個噁心的小玻璃杯拿走。它把我這高檔場所都給薰臭了。

column1: Clever, Pharkas, very clever. Hope you got a good many points for this.
column2: 聰明啊，法卡斯，真聰明。希望你這招能為你加不少分。

column1: My anus sphincter is in perfect health, thank you very much. I move my bowels twice a day, and never strain. What's more, I find your offer most distasteful.
column2: 我的肛門括約肌好得很，謝謝關心。我一天排便兩次，從不用力。而且，我覺得你這提議相當令人反感。

column1: You are a desperate individual, Pharkas. I do not give handouts.
column2: 你真是走投無路了，法卡斯。我可不做施捨這種事。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|You are a swine, a cad, and a rank bounder!|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|你這隻豬，無賴又下流的傢伙！|c|

column1: What say?
column2: 你說啥？

column1: I said, "Your fine Dad was the bank founder."
column2: 我是說，「令尊當年可是這家銀行的創辦人。」

column1: Oh! Yes, indeed!
column2: 喔！沒錯，正是如此！

column1: Do not attempt to threaten me with your puny ice pick, Pharkas. I have the protection of the local constabulary.
column2: 別想拿你那把破冰錐威脅我，法卡斯。我有本地警方保護。

column1: This is trash. Away with it!
column2: 這是垃圾。拿走！

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|It's not the ONLY trash in here.|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|這裡的垃圾可不只這一件。|c|

column1: I can't hear you. What was that?
column2: 我聽不清楚。你說什麼？

column1: I said, "There's lots of lonely cash in here."
column2: 我是說，「這裡有好多寂寞的現金呢。」

column1: Oh. Whatever you say.
column2: 喔，隨你怎麼說。

column1: You always were a strapping lad. Heh. heh.
column2: 你一直都是個健壯的小夥子啊。呵，呵。

column1: Your concern is misplaced, Pharkas. I'm perfectly safe in here. You may go. And don't permit the door to strike your posterior as you depart!
column2: 你的擔心是多餘的，法卡斯。我在這裡安全得很。你可以走了。出去時，可別讓門打到你的屁股！

column1: Are you suggesting that I need something like this? I'll have you know I never expel gas!
column2: 你是在暗示我需要這種東西嗎？告訴你，我從不放屁！

column1: (SOTTO VOCE) |c1|Maybe you SHOULD, then, before you EXPLODE.|c|
column2: （壓低聲音） |c1|那你或許該放一下，免得爆炸。|c|

column1: I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that.
column2: 抱歉，我沒聽清楚。

column1: I'm sorry, I said, "Maybe I should spend more time in the commode."
column2: 抱歉，我是說，「也許我該多花點時間蹲馬桶。」

column1: Oh! Well, I don't want to hear about your personal problems.
column2: 喔！好吧，我不想聽你私人的問題。

column1: Snails? What am I supposed to do with these, deposit them? You're even more demented than I gave you credit for, Pharkas.
column2: 蝸牛？你要我拿這些做什麼，存進戶頭嗎？法卡斯，你比我想像的還要瘋。

column1: I'd be happy to keep it safe in your Christmas Club account here at the Bank of Bob. If you'd open one, that is.
column2: 我很樂意把它安全地放進你在鮑伯銀行的聖誕俱樂部帳戶裡。前提是你得先開一個。

column1: Beer is the beverage of morons. Take it elsewhere forthwith.
column2: 啤酒是蠢蛋的飲料。馬上拿去別處。

column1: (SOTTO VOCE) |c1|You worthless waste of space.|c|
column2: （壓低聲音） |c1|你這個佔位置的沒用東西。|c|

column1: Did you just say something?
column2: 你剛剛說了什麼嗎？

column1: I said, "Your worth is based on taste."
column2: 我是說，「你的價值，取決於品味。」

column1: Oh. Yes, I've invested a fortune in these beautiful paintings!
column2: 喔，沒錯，我在這些美麗的畫作上投資了一大筆錢！

column1: I don't need any of your castoffs, Pharkas. Throw them out yourself.
column2: 我不需要你那些淘汰品，法卡斯。自己拿去丟了吧。

column1: I don't recognize that key. It certainly opens nothing around here!
column2: 我不認得那把鑰匙。反正在這裡它什麼都打不開！

column1: (SOTTO VOCE) |c1|Like the key to your generosity.|c|
column2: （壓低聲音） |c1|就像打開你那份大方的鑰匙一樣。|c|

column1: Say again, please.
column2: 麻煩再說一次。

column1: I said, "Look at me, I'm a sight to see!"
column2: 我是說，「你看看我，可真是賞心悅目啊！」

column1: Oh. You look pretty scrawny to me.
column2: 喔，我看你倒是挺瘦弱的。

column1: Still trying to get to the top of the ladder, eh, Pharkas? I suppose this is the only way you're going to do it.
column2: 還在想爬上梯子頂端啊，法卡斯？我看這大概是你唯一能爬上去的辦法了。

column1: You don't have the gumption to tie me up, Pharkas.
column2: 你沒那個膽子把我綁起來的，法卡斯。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|And I don't have enough rope, either!|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|反正我繩子也不夠用！|c|

column1: What was that? What did you say?
column2: 什麼？你剛說什麼？

column1: I said, "You don't happen to be a dope, either."
column2: 我是說，「你倒也不像個傻瓜。」

column1: Oh. Too true, too true! Heh, heh.
column2: 喔，說得太對了，太對了！呵，呵。

column1: Cease your ridiculous antics, Pharkas. Do I look like a cow to you?
column2: 別再耍那些荒唐把戲了，法卡斯。我看起來像頭牛嗎？

column1: I'm not experiencing any of the lower G.I. problems that so many of the rabble seem to be afflicted with. Therefore, feel free to take that solution elsewhere.
column2: 我可沒有那些低下階層常有的腸胃毛病。所以，這帖藥你拿去別處用吧。

column1: That canister has no redemption value at all. But thank you so much for thinking of us here at the Bank of Bob.
column2: 那個罐子完全沒有兌換價值。不過還是很謝謝你想到我們鮑伯銀行。

column1: I'm sorry, you backwoods pharmacist. We do not accept large deposits of baking soda!
column2: 抱歉了，鄉巴佬藥師。我們不接受大量的小蘇打存款！

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|You're full of hot air.|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|你這人真是滿口廢話。|c|

column1: Excuse me? What did you say?
column2: 你說什麼？再說一次？

column1: I simply said, "You've got a full head of hair."
column2: 我只是說，「你的頭髮真是茂密。」

column1: Oh. Yes, do you like it? It's imported.
column2: 喔，是啊，你喜歡嗎？這是進口貨。

column1: Vulgar displays of pulchritude do not impress me, Pharkas.
column2: 低俗的美色炫耀，可打動不了我，法卡斯。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c2|You're no saint, you no-account rear!|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c2|你才不是什麼聖人，你這沒用的屁股精！|c|

column1: Pardonne moi?
column2: 敢問，您說什麼？

column1: I merely say, "I ain't got no account here!"
column2: 我只是說，「我在這兒可沒開戶。」

column1: Oh. Well, whose fault is that?
column2: 喔，那是誰的錯呢？

column1: I find your wax utterly irrelevant.
column2: 我覺得你的蠟一點都不重要。

column1: (SOTTO VOCE) |c1|Yeah, and I find YOU utterly an elephant!|c|
column2: （壓低聲音） |c1|是啊，我覺得你完全就是頭大象！|c|

column1: I'm sorry? Please repeat that, I missed it.
column2: 抱歉？麻煩再說一次，我沒聽到。

column1: I said, "I think you are a hell of a gent."
column2: 我是說，「我覺得您真是個了不起的紳士。」

column1: Oh. Yes!
column2: 喔，沒錯！

column1: What damage do you think you're going to do with that little penknife? Just remember, Pharkas, I've got friends in this town. Powerful friends. Not like your flea-bitten pals. So don't threaten me. Your day will come. And soon, too, I guarantee you.
column2: 你以為拿那把小折刀能造成什麼傷害？記住了，法卡斯，我在這鎮上有朋友。有力的朋友。可不像你那些渾身跳蚤的哥兒們。所以別想威脅我。你的報應快來了。而且很快，這我跟你保證。

column1: You hand the safe-deposit key to P.H. Balance.
column2: 你把保管箱鑰匙交給P·H·貝倫斯。

column1: It'll be ready Tuesday. OH! I mean, allow me to fetch your safe-deposit box for you immediately.
column2: 星期二就會好了。噢！我是說，容我立刻幫您把保管箱取來。

column1: You level your pistol at the Banker.
column2: 你把手槍瞄準銀行家。

column1: You try it, Pharkas, and you'll wind up hanging from the tallest limb in town. The Sheriff and I are keeping our eyes on you. One wrong move, and you're history.
column2: 你敢試試看，法卡斯，你就等著吊在鎮上最高的那根樹枝上吧。警長跟我都盯著你呢。一步錯，你就完了。

column1: You lower your pistol. You hate to admit it, but he's right; you'd never get away with shooting him in cold blood.
column2: 你放下了手槍。你雖然不願承認，但他說得沒錯；你絕不可能就這樣冷血斃了他還能全身而退。

column1: Don't try to bribe me with pie, Pharkas. I'm not some backwoods hick like some of the folks in this one-horse town.
column2: 別想拿派來賄賂我，法卡斯。我可不是這種鳥不生蛋小鎮上的鄉巴佬。

column1: Thank you, Pharkas, but no thank you. I prefer a more cultured beverage, specifically, tea.
column2: 謝了，法卡斯，不過還是免了。我偏好更有格調的飲料，具體來說，是茶。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|I hope you choke on your tea!|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|希望你被茶給嗆死！|c|

column1: What did you say, Pharkas?
column2: 你說什麼，法卡斯？

column1: I said, "I guess the joke is on me!"
column2: 我是說，「我看這玩笑是開在我自己頭上了！」

column1: Oh! Yes, I suppose it is, isn't it?
column2: 喔！是啊，我想也是，不是嗎？

column1: What am I supposed to do with this? It's not bankable. Take it away.
column2: 你要我拿這個做什麼？這又不能存進銀行。拿走吧。

column1: (QUIETLY) |c1|You've got your nerve, you dirtpile.|c|
column2: （小聲地） |c1|你這堆爛泥還真有膽子。|c|

column1: Huh? What was that?
column2: 嗯？你說什麼？

column1: I said, "You've got verve and earthy style."
column2: 我是說，「您真是活力充沛、自成一格。」

column1: Oh! That is so!
column2: 喔！正是如此！

column1: I do not accept these as currency. In fact, I prefer not to have them in my bank! Please remove them forthwith or I shall have to remove them myself.
column2: 我不接受這些當貨幣。事實上，我根本不想讓這些東西出現在我銀行裡！請立刻拿走，不然我就得自己動手了。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|Any stinkin' day, you dried-up horse.|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|隨便哪個臭天，你這匹乾癟老馬。|c|

column1: Pardon me? Come again?
column2: 什麼？再說一次？

column1: I said, "Anything you say. You're right, of course."
column2: 我是說，「您說什麼都對，您當然是對的。」

column1: Oh! Well, of course I am.
column2: 喔！那當然，我當然是對的。

column1: I'm sure this silver is not investment-grade. Nice try, Pharkas. But hang onto it. It probably has great sentimental value. (SNICKER)
column2: 我肯定這銀子不夠投資等級。想得美，法卡斯。不過你還是留著吧。它大概很有紀念價值。（竊笑）

column1: It's an interesting trinket, but hardly worth my time. Take it back, Pharkas.
column2: 這是個有趣的小玩意兒，但不值得我花時間。拿回去吧，法卡斯。

column1: That suit is clearly meant for somebody much scrawnier and less robust than me. Take it away.
column2: 那套衣服顯然是給比我瘦弱得多的人穿的。拿走吧。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|One of these days... bang, zoom!|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|總有一天…咚，轟，一拳飛月球！|c|

column1: Oh, I just said, "One of these days, banking boom!"
column2: 喔，我只是說，「總有一天，銀行業務蒸蒸日上！」

column1: Oh! I certainly hope so.
column2: 喔！我當然希望如此。

column1: It'll be ready on Tuesday, Pharkas. Hehe... just making a funny. This isn't redeemable here.
column2: 星期二就會好了，法卡斯。嘿嘿…開個玩笑而已。這東西在這裡兌換不了。

column1: Take those smelly old things away, or I shall be forced to remove you bodily from this bank!
column2: 把那些又臭又舊的東西拿走，不然我就得親自把你架出這間銀行！

column1: (SOTTO VOCE) |c1|Yeah, you think so? You'd be sorry.|c|
column2: （壓低聲音） |c1|哼，你以為你辦得到？你會後悔的。|c|

column1: I'm sorry, what did you just say?
column2: 抱歉，你剛說了什麼？

column1: I said, "Yeah, they stink like calamari."
column2: 我是說，「是啊，它們臭得像魷魚圈。」

column1: Oh! Yes, exactly.
column2: 喔！對，一點也沒錯。

column1: I don't want your smelly old neckerchief! Wrap it around your scrawny li'l chicken gullet or something.
column2: 我才不要你那條又臭又舊的領巾！拿去纏你那細瘦的雞脖子吧。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|I sure can't believe you smell so rank!|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|真不敢相信你臭成這副德性！|c|

column1: What was that, Pharkas?
column2: 你說什麼，法卡斯？

column1: I said, "You sure have achieved a swell bank."
column2: 我是說，「您這銀行辦得可真是有模有樣。」

column1: Oh! Why, thank you. I'm proud of it.
column2: 喔！哎呀，謝謝。我對它很自豪。

column1: Ah, yes, a letter from your worthless crony Mr. Graves. A shame he had to die.
column2: 啊，是啊，一封來自你那沒用死黨葛雷夫斯先生的信。可惜他非死不可。

column1: Taking up digging, are we? Couldn't make a go of that pharmacy, eh? I'm not surprised. You haven't demonstrated much business sense.
column2: 改行挖土啦？藥局經營不下去了，是吧？我一點也不意外。你向來沒什麼生意頭腦。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|I'd like to dig a grave for YOU.|c|
column2: （低聲嘀咕） |c1|我倒想幫你挖個墳。|c|

column1: Speak up, Pharkas, I can hardly hear you.
column2: 大聲點，法卡斯，我幾乎聽不到。

column1: I said, "I'd like to invest my savings with you!"
column2: 我是說，「我想把我的存款交給你投資！」

column1: Oh. I'm sure we can arrange something at a later date.
column2: 喔，我相信我們日後一定能安排點什麼。

column1: What is this, your lunch? Take it away, Pharkas, I'm watching my weight.
column2: 這是什麼，你的午餐？拿走吧，法卡斯，我在控制體重。

column1: I don't require a bag for anything. Goodbye.
column2: 我什麼都不需要袋子裝。再見。

column1: (SHOUTING) Remove that filth from my bank at once, do you hear? And while you're at it, remove yourself, too!
column2: （大吼）馬上把那髒東西從我銀行裡拿走，聽到沒？順便也把你自己一起弄走！

column1: I don't appreciate you throwing clay around my bank, Pharkas! Please remove it from the vicinity immediately.
column2: 我不喜歡你在我銀行裡到處亂丟黏土，法卡斯！請立刻把它清離這附近。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|You're asking for it, dude.|c|
column2: （小聲） |c1|你這是自找罵挨，臭小子。|c|

column1: What was that?
column2: 你說什麼？

column1: I said, "As you asked, I was so rude."
column2: 我是說：「你問我，我才失禮的嘛。」

column1: Oh! Yes, that is correct!
column2: 哦！對，沒錯！

column1: I do not recall asking you to provide me with your phony nostrums and fraudulent potions. In fact, I believe that's what I'll call you: Freddy Pharkas, Fraudulent Phony! Heh heh!
column2: 我不記得有請你來兜售什麼騙人的偏方和造假的藥水。這樣好了，我看就叫你「佛萊迪·法卡斯，招搖撞騙的假貨大王」吧！嘿嘿！

column1: I'm all done now.
column2: 我這邊搞定了。

column1: Thank you for using the Bank of Bob.
column2: 謝謝惠顧鮑伯銀行。

column1: You see the green flocked wallpaper, rough-hewn wood floor, and tinned tile ceiling of The Bank of Bob, Coarsegold's first (and probably last!) financial institution.
column2: 你看到鮑伯銀行裡的綠色絨面壁紙、粗糙的木地板，以及錫片天花板——這是粗金鎮第一間（大概也是最後一間！）金融機構。

column1: Being a little touchy-feely today, aren't you, Pharkas?
column2: 今天手怎麼這麼閒不下來啊，法卡斯？

column1: The vault door is two solid feet of case-hardened, high-carbon balsa wood, painted gray to look metallic and fool would-be bank robbers.
column2: 這道金庫門是兩呎厚的實心硬化高碳輕木（巴沙木），漆成灰色，看起來像金屬，好唬弄想來搶劫的傢伙。

column1: Tut tut, Freddy m'boy, y'all can't get in thet door without the combination... I'll be happy to bring out your safe-deposit box, long as you've got the key.
column2: 嘖嘖，佛萊迪小子，沒有密碼你休想打開那扇門……只要你有鑰匙，我很樂意幫你把保管箱拿出來。

column1: Yes, you could probably dig through the vault door in short order using the ice pick... and then plunder the entire town of its valuables! But you don't have any use for two pieces of rusty costume jewelry and a form letter signed by Millard Fillmore.
column2: 沒錯，你大概可以拿冰錐沒幾下就把金庫門挖穿……然後把全鎮的財寶洗劫一空！可惜裡頭只有兩件生鏽的仿冒首飾，還有一封米勒德·菲爾莫爾簽名的制式信，你要來也沒用。

column1: Phineas H. Balance has cleverly situated a newfangled box camera up in the corner to photograph customers. Only trouble is, most customers don't stand in one place for 15 minutes.
column2: 菲尼亞斯·H·貝倫斯很聰明地在角落架了台新式箱型相機，用來拍顧客。唯一的問題是，大部分顧客可不會乖乖站在原地十五分鐘。

column1: It's too high up to reach. That's okay, you'd take a lousy shot anyway.
column2: 太高了搆不到。反正你拍出來的照片也好不到哪去。

column1: It's P.H. Balance's clock, eternally set to 3:57 so that he can hustle people out of the bank with a "We're closing in five minutes!"
column2: 這是P·H·貝倫斯的時鐘，永遠停在三點五十七分，好讓他能用一句「我們五分鐘後打烊！」把客人趕出銀行。

column1: You can't reach it; it's on the wrong side of the gate.
column2: 你搆不到，它在門的另一邊。

column1: A couple of pretty cameo portraits of P.H. Balance's favorite "pin-up girl."
column2: 幾幅漂亮的浮雕肖像，畫的是P·H·貝倫斯最愛的「性感女郎」。

column1: That Carrie Nation is such a looker!
column2: 這位凱莉·內申還真是個美人胚子！

column1: You'd never get away with them.
column2: 你絕對拿不走這些東西的。

column1: A masterful portrait of P.H. Balance's father, Bacillus Ophicleide Balance (or B.O.B. for short). It's got a little plaque. Apparently it doesn't have time to brush between meals.
column2: 一幅精湛的畫像，畫的是P·H·貝倫斯的父親——巴西勒斯·歐菲克萊德·貝倫斯（簡稱B.O.B.）。畫框上掛著一塊小牌匾，想必畫中人三餐之間都沒空刷牙，牙菌斑不少。

column1: You're a mean-lookin' sonnuvabitch, y'know that?
column2: 你這混帳長得真兇，你知道嗎？

column1: Mr. Pharkas, I'm afraid my father cannot hear you any longer... he's been dead for many years now. But I'm sure he would've appreciated your sentiment.
column2: 法卡斯先生，恐怕我父親再也聽不到你說話了……他已經過世多年。不過我想他一定會很欣賞你這番心意。

column1: Upon closer examination, you realize that the entire painting is a trompe l'oeil. Even the frame is actually just painted on the wall. "Bob" must've wanted to make sure that he stayed hung.
column2: 你仔細一看才發現，整幅畫其實是幅視錯覺畫。就連畫框也只是畫在牆上的。看來「鮑伯」是鐵了心要讓自己「掛」得長長久久。

column1: It's not accessible behind the teller's window.
column2: 那在櫃檯窗口後面，你碰不到。

column1: It's a velvet mural that depicts the driving of the Golden Spike as performed by a toreador and a couple of children with really big, sad eyes.
column2: 這是一幅絲絨壁畫，畫的是一名鬥牛士和幾個眼睛又大又哀傷的小孩，一起釘下那根「黃金道釘」的場景。

column1: You don't want it. You saw it at the Starving Artists of Fresno sale and you decided it wasn't worth the $0.14 they wanted for it.
column2: 你才不想要。你在「弗雷斯諾窮畫家特賣會」上看過這幅畫，當時就覺得連他們開的0.14美元都不值。

column1: Some sort of large potted fern is standing in the corner.
column2: 角落擺著一大盆蕨類植物。

column1: Hey, you're a healthy one, aintcha?
column2: 嘿，你長得挺健康的嘛，是吧？

column1: The plant shifts its leaves slightly as if to say, "Yes, this is a calm, restful environment in which to grow and flourish. It would be perfect were it not for the negative vibrations I receive from that miserly banker. Say, do you have any plant food?"
column2: 這盆植物微微搖了搖葉子，彷彿在說：「沒錯，這裡環境安靜、適合成長茁壯。要不是老感受到那個小氣銀行家散發出來的負能量，簡直堪稱完美。對了，你有沒有植物肥料？」

column1: Do you like it? That's my "plant on premises!"
column2: 你喜歡嗎？這可是俺安插在店裡的「眼線」——不，是盆栽啦！

column1: One of the local plants has been pulled up and potted.
column2: 一株本地植物被連根拔起，種進了花盆裡。

column1: Hey, you're a nice little plant, aren't you? Yes, you are!
column2: 嘿，你這小盆栽真乖，對吧？就是你！

column1: The plant rustles its leaves slightly, as if to say, "Aw, g'wan witcha, yer just full of compliments today."
column2: 這盆植物微微沙沙作響，彷彿在說：「哎唷，少來了啦，你今天嘴巴真甜。」

column1: Excuse me there, Mr. Pharkas. Please don't touch the Poison Ivy.
column2: 抱歉，法卡斯先生。麻煩別碰那盆毒藤。

column1: This heavy table is where customers fill out bank slips and examine their safe-deposit boxes.
column2: 這張厚重的桌子是給顧客填寫銀行單據、檢查保管箱用的。

column1: There's nothing on the desk you need to take.
column2: 桌上沒有你需要拿的東西。

column1: This quill pen is used to fill out slips and sign registers.
column2: 這支羽毛筆是用來填單據、簽登記簿的。

column1: You don't need to sign anything.
column2: 你不需要簽什麼東西。

column1: There's a register here for new customers. If they sign in, they'll get all the usual brochures prompting them to take advantage of The Bank of Bob's home equity loans and other really smart investments.
column2: 這裡有本給新顧客用的登記簿。只要簽了名，就會收到一堆宣傳手冊，慫恿他們申辦鮑伯銀行的房屋淨值貸款和其他「高明」的投資項目。

column1: Thumbing through the bank register, you discover that little Charlie Keating's kid has an account here!
column2: 你翻閱銀行登記簿，發現小查理·基廷家的小孩居然在這裡開了戶頭！

column1: Hmm. I guess that's how little acorns grow into mighty oaks... one penny at a time.
column2: 嗯。我猜這就是小橡實長成參天大樹的道理……一分錢一分錢慢慢存。

column1: This authentic mohair rug is much like the one P.H. Balance wears on his head. After all, he needs much mohair than he has!
column2: 這頂道地的馬海毛假髮，跟P·H·貝倫斯自己頭上戴的那頂挺像的。畢竟他頭上的毛，可比他擁有的還「多毛」得多！

column1: Nope, no trap doors, keys, dirt or blank checks.
column2: 沒有，沒有暗門、鑰匙、泥土，也沒有空白支票。

column1: This cute li'l fence separates the "Officials Only" area from the "Customers and Other Unwelcome Guests" area.
column2: 這道小巧可愛的柵欄，把「僅限行員」區和「顧客與其他不受歡迎人士」區隔了開來。

column1: That area is off-limits to everyone except people who work at the bank, Mr. Pharkas!
column2: 那個區域除了銀行員工，誰都不准進去，法卡斯先生！

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|I guess that leaves YOU out, eh?|c|
column2: （小聲） |c1|我猜這下把你也排除在外了，嗯？|c|

column1: Pardon me? What did you say?
column2: 你說什麼？

column1: I said, "I guess you've got a lot of clout."
column2: 我是說：「我猜你這人挺有身份的。」

column1: Oh. That is correct, sir!
column2: 哦，沒錯，先生！

column1: It's always nice to see a small town like Coarsegold get some big-city tackiness like this horrible chandelier.
column2: 像粗金鎮這種小鎮，能沾染上這種俗不可耐的大城市風格——就像這盞可怕的吊燈——總是叫人欣慰。

column1: I understand that certain ruffians enjoy swinging from the chandeliers, Mr. Pharkas, but if it's not too much trouble, please try to restrain yourself.
column2: 我知道有些粗人喜歡攀著吊燈盪來盪去，法卡斯先生，但如果不麻煩的話，還請你克制一下。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|Ah, you're just a warped, frustrated old man.|c|
column2: （小聲） |c1|哼，你不過是個乖僻又憋屈的老頭。|c|

column1: Pardon me? What was that you just said?
column2: 你剛剛說什麼？

column1: I said, "You're a warm, first-rated old man."
column2: 我是說：「您是位親切又一流的老先生。」

column1: It's Phineas's file cabinet.
column2: 這是菲尼亞斯的檔案櫃。

column1: Mr. Pharkas, those are Bank files. They're not for your perusal.
column2: 法卡斯先生，那些是銀行的檔案，不是給你翻閱的。

column1: (UNDER BREATH) |c1|Right, you depraved, rotten old ass.|c|
column2: （小聲） |c1|沒錯，你這下流的老渾蛋。|c|

column1: Excuse me? What was that you said?
column2: 你說什麼？

column1: I said, "You're brave and you've got class."
column2: 我是說：「您真勇敢，又有格調。」

column1: Oh. Yes, that is correct, sir!
column2: 哦，對，沒錯，先生！

column1: These are the tellers' stations.
column2: 這些是行員的櫃檯。

column1: There's nothing on the counter to take.
column2: 櫃檯上沒有你需要拿的東西。

column1: Wanna sell me your property? You won't regret it!
column2: 想把你的地賣給我嗎？你絕對不會後悔！

column1: Yep. I want the cashola!
column2: 沒錯，我要的就是鈔票！

column1: And give up my dreams of herohood? Never, you CAD!
column2: 放棄我當英雄的夢想？休想，你這卑鄙小人！

column1: Someone's head was accidentally rapped sharply against the plaster here, during an ugly incident in which a customer asked for free checking.
column2: 有人的頭曾經不小心狠狠撞上這裡的灰泥牆——那是一次醜陋事件的下場，起因是有位顧客要求辦免費支票帳戶。

column1: Don't pick at it! You'll only make it worse.
column2: 別去摳它！只會弄得更糟。

column1: You'd forgotten... you used your old lucky neckerchief to wrap those pistols in!
column2: 你都忘了……你用那條幸運領巾把手槍包起來了！

column1: You take your lucky neckerchief out of the safe deposit box. Now you're REALLY beginning to feel lucky!
column2: 你從保管箱裡拿出幸運領巾。現在你才真的開始覺得幸運起來！

column1: Wait a minute, the last time I wore this was when Kenny shot off my ear back in St. Louis.
column2: 等等，上次我戴這條領巾，就是肯尼在聖路易斯把我耳朵打掉的那次。

column1: Well, okay. So maybe it's not THAT lucky a neckerchief!
column2: 好吧，看來這條領巾也沒那麼幸運！

column1: These are your two gunslinger pistols, left over from your salad days. You know... those days when you were still green!
column2: 這是你當年快槍手時代留下的兩把手槍。你知道的……就是你還嫩得很的那段日子！

column1: You lovingly lift your pistols from the box where they've spent the past decade.
column2: 你滿懷感情地把手槍從那個放了十年的盒子裡拿出來。

column1: It's your safe deposit box. You haven't even LOOKED in this box for... what, ten years now? Ever since you moved to Coarsegold!
column2: 這是你的保管箱。你已經有……十年沒打開看過了吧？自從你搬來粗金鎮之後就沒開過！

column1: You don't need to put anything in the safe-deposit box. Your future is too uncertain to store anything long-term!
column2: 你不需要往保管箱裡放東西。你的未來太不確定了，實在不適合做長期儲蓄！

column1: It's the honorable Sheriff Checkum P. Shift, trying to invent "coffee and donuts."
column2: 這位是德高望重的警長切肯·P·席夫特，正在嘗試發明「咖啡配甜甜圈」。

column1: Sheriff!
column2: 警長！

column1: Pharkberg! Whudda YEW want?
column2: 法克伯格！你想幹嘛？

column1: Why'd you close down the Dirty Sheets Hotel?
column2: 你為什麼把「髒床單旅館」給關了？

column1: Whut's it to ya?
column2: 干你什麼事？

column1: Well, I... I'm a little worried about the tourist trade, and...
column2: 呃，我……我是有點擔心觀光生意啦，而且……

column1: It's not yer place to worry about the "tourist trade," bwoy! Leave that to ME! Now, as fer the Hotel, IF it's any o' yer business, it wuz attractin' the wrong sorta bizniz... transients, hobos, people of low moral fiber. Cain't be havin' none o' THET goin' on in Coarsegold, can we?
column2: 「觀光生意」用不著你操心，小子！那是俺的事！至於那間旅館嘛，如果真的跟你有關係的話，是招來了些不三不四的人——流浪漢、遊民、品性低劣的傢伙。粗金鎮可容不下那種東西，是吧？

column1: But at the rate these places are closing down, there won't be any town LEFT in a matter of days!
column2: 可是照這樣關店的速度，再過沒幾天，這鎮上就什麼都不剩了！

column1: Lissen to me, bwoy. Thet ain't none of my never mind. I'm jus' lookin' to make this place as SAFE as kin be. So if I gotta close down a place or two, welp, y'all will jus' hafta live with that.
column2: 聽好了，小子。那可不干俺的事。俺就是想把這地方弄得盡量安全。要是俺得關個一兩間店，呃，你就得自己想開點。

column1: <|c3|Hoccccccccccck...|c|> <|c3|pa-tooey!|c|>
The spittoon makes a resounding "ping!"
column2: 痰盂發出響亮的一聲「鏘！」

column1: Sheriff, I don't understand how the Opera House was making Coarsegold unsafe. Why'd you close it down?
column2: 警長，我不懂歌劇院怎麼會讓粗金鎮變得不安全。你幹嘛把它關了？

column1: They was showin' SMUT in there, and it wuz attractin' the wrong kinda customer!
column2: 他們在裡頭演那些下流玩意，招來一堆不三不四的客人！

column1: Smut? Like what?
column2: 下流玩意？比如說？

column1: Chaucer! Rebelais! Baaaaalzac!
column2: 喬叟！哈伯雷！巴——爾扎克！

column1: And furthermore...
column2: 而且呢……

column1: Whut the Sam Hill do yew want now? Don't you have customers to git to, Pharkenstein?
column2: 你這下又想幹嘛？你不是還有客人要招呼嗎，法克斯坦？

column1: Yes, but I don't see why you had to close down the Tall & Thin Shop! What in the world was wrong with THAT?
column2: 對啦，可是我不懂你幹嘛把「高瘦人用品店」也關了！那間到底是哪裡有問題？

column1: Lissen to me, bwoy. Tall & thin folks are SNEAKY.
column2: 聽好了，小子。又高又瘦的人啊，鬼鬼祟祟的。

column1: Oh, that's ridiculous.
column2: 喔，這太荒謬了。

column1: It's NOT ridiculous! They look down on everbuddy, and when they wanna sneak around, they turn sideways towards ya so's you cain't hardly see 'em! Luckily, their collarbones break more easily than most folks', so's you kin' whup on 'em realll good.
column2: 才不荒謬咧！他們個個看不起人，想偷偷摸摸的時候，還會側身對著你，讓你根本看不清楚他們！好在他們的鎖骨比一般人脆弱，你要收拾他們可容易得很。

column1: That's the most insane load of horse manure I've ever heard.
column2: 這是我聽過最扯的胡說八道。

column1: Nobody's askin' yew to believe it, bwoy. Iffn yew don't like how ah'm running this town, why, yew jus' go right on and leave. In fact, ah should be seein' yew about this VERY soon, bwoy. VERY soon.
column2: 沒人要你信，小子。你要是看不慣俺管這鎮子的方式，那就儘管走人。說真的，俺很快就會找你談這件事了，小子。非常快。

column1: Sheriff, do YOU aim to do anything about the flatulent horses out there?
column2: 警長，你打算對外頭那些放屁馬做點什麼嗎？

column1: Not much ah CAN do, Pharkwat. Yew cain't go 'round pluggin' up the horses, they'll explode. We'll jus' have to set tight 'til they get over it.
column2: 俺也沒什麼好做的，法克瓦特。你總不能到處去堵馬屁股，牠們會爆炸的。俺們就只能坐著等牠們自己好起來。

column1: But the town will be gassed to death by then! We've got to take action NOW!
column2: 可是到那時候全鎮早就被毒氣毒死了！我們現在就得行動！

column1: I AM takin' action, bwoy! Ah'm catchin' up on m' office work! Cain't go outside anyways 'til this whole thang blows over! HYUK HYUK! I made a funny there! "Blows over." Git it? Git it?
column2: 俺就是在採取行動啊，小子！俺正在補辦公室的積案呢！反正這整件事「吹」過去之前俺也出不了門！哈哈哈！俺剛剛講了個笑話！「吹」過去。懂了吧？懂了吧？

column1: That's whut I'm here fer, bwoy.
column2: 這就是俺存在的意義啊，小子。

column1: Sheriff, if you're not going to help these people, then I am.
column2: 警長，你要是不肯幫這些人，那我來。

column1: Yew do whut yew hafta, bwoy. Iffn yew think yew kin cure them horses 'afore evvabuddy gits gassed, yer welcome to try! <snicker>
column2: 你想幹嘛就去幹嘛吧，小子。你要是覺得能在大家被熏死之前治好那些馬，儘管去試試看！<竊笑>

column1: Sheriff! Are you going to help me stop that stampede before it runs over the whole town?
column2: 警長！你要幫我阻止那群暴衝的牛群踩爛全鎮嗎？

column1: Now look here, Pharkblatt! Stoppin' them horses from pootin' the town away wuz all well and good, but yew cain't stop a stampede, can ya? Why, there's nuttin' to be done but batten down the hatches and hope fer the best! Me, I figure I'm safe in here, this's the only buildin' in town made outta rock! You go save yer own butt, bwoy, or git outta town like the smart folks are doin'.
column2: 你聽好了，法克布拉特！阻止那些馬把全鎮放屁放垮是一回事，可暴衝的牛群你能擋得住嗎？這種事根本沒轍，只能關緊門窗，祈禱平安過關！俺自己嘛，躲在這裡最安全，這可是鎮上唯一一棟石頭蓋的房子！你自己顧好自己吧，小子，不然就跟聰明人一樣，趕緊離開這鎮子。

column1: Dag nab you, Sheriff! You're not doing ANYTHING to help!
column2: 去你的，警長！你根本什麼忙都沒幫！

column1: Why, shore ah am! Ah'm refusin' to PANIC!
column2: 怎麼沒有，俺可是拒絕恐慌呢！

column1: Grrrr.
Sheriff, I'm not jokin'. Get a posse together! We can round 'em up, I KNOW we can!
column2: 警長，我不是在開玩笑。快召集人手！我們可以把牠們趕回去，我知道我們辦得到！

column1: Y'all mus' think ah'm CRAZY, bwoy! Yew wouldn't catch me outside this office 'til thet stampede is over! Now git along!
column2: 你一定覺得俺瘋了吧，小子！在那群牛群平息之前，你休想看到俺踏出這辦公室半步！現在快滾吧！

column1: Welp, Sheriff, I stopped that stampede, no thanks to you.
column2: 好啦，警長，我已經擋下那群牛了，一點都不多虧你。

column1: Say WHUT? But... how?
column2: 你說什麼？可是……怎麼辦到的？

column1: A little Yankee ingenuity. Something you wouldn't know anything about.
column2: 一點北方佬的小聰明。這你大概是一竅不通。

column1: Hey hey! Yer beginnin' to really PIDDLE ME OFF, bwoy! Yer spozed to be shuttin' down yer Pharmacy and leavin' town, yer NOT spozed to be runnin' around like the flippin' Lone Ranger, savin' people right and left! Ah don't wanna hafta -- ah sez, ah don't wanna hafta talk to yew about this AGIN! Fer yer own safety, just vamoose!
column2: 嘿嘿！你這下真的開始惹毛俺了，小子！你應該要關了藥局、滾出這鎮子，不是像什麼獨行俠一樣到處跑，見人就救！俺不想再——俺說，俺不想再為這事跟你談第二次！為了你自己好，快滾吧！

column1: I don't suppose you could help me rescue an Indian from an anthill?
column2: 我猜你大概沒辦法幫我把一個印地安人從螞蟻窩裡救出來吧？

column1: No, ah don't suppose ah could! There's places in town whut need more fire inspections. Git along.
column2: 沒錯，俺是沒辦法！鎮上還有幾個地方要去做消防檢查呢。快滾吧。

column1: Sheriff, I know you couldn't care less, but folks around town are having some sort of mysterious stomach ailment.
column2: 警長，我知道你根本不在乎，可是鎮上的人都得了某種神秘的腸胃病。

column1: Welp, guess the water in these parts has gone sour. Ain't no surprise, really, it were bound to happen sooner or later. I figger those that don't die from the dysentery will jus' have to pull up stakes and find someplace where the water's good.
column2: 呃，俺猜這一帶的水大概是壞了。這也不奇怪，遲早都會發生的事。俺想沒被痢疾弄死的人，大概就得收拾家當，找個水質好一點的地方去了。

column1: I don't think that's it at all. I think somebody poisoned the water. If you were any kind of Sheriff, you'd look into it.
column2: 我才不覺得是這樣。我認為有人在水裡下毒。你要是個稱職的警長，就該去查一查。

column1: HYUK HYUK! Like yew know ANYTHANG about bein' a Sheriff! 'Sides, ah know the water ain't poisoned, ah had some m'self awhile ago.
column2: 哈哈哈！說得好像你懂什麼叫警長似的！再說了，俺知道水沒被下毒，俺自己前陣子才喝過呢。

column1: I'm going to cure the poor folks of this town if it's the last thing I do!
column2: 就算是我做的最後一件事，我也要治好這鎮上那些可憐人！

column1: Yep, an' it's gonna BE the last thing yew do iffn yew don't stop MESSIN' AROUND with the fine people of Coarsegold!
column2: 沒錯，你要是再不停止對粗金鎮這些善良百姓瞎搞，那還真的會是你做的最後一件事！

column1: Messing around? I'm trying to SAVE them, dammit!
column2: 瞎搞？老子這是在救他們，該死的！

column1: |c0|Yew cuss at me one mo' time and ah'll throw yew in jail so fast yew'll be BEGGIN' me to let yew quit, restore or restart!|c|
column2: |c0|你再敢對俺罵一句髒話，俺立刻把你關進牢裡，快到你會求俺讓你「結束遊戲」、「讀取存檔」或「重新開始」！|c|

column1: I apologize.
column2: 我道歉。

column1: That's better. See? Now we kin all be friends.
column2: 這樣才對嘛。看吧？這樣大家都可以當朋友了。

column1: Sheriff, I'm going to be saying my goodbyes soon, and I just wanted to thank you for all your help.
column2: 警長，我很快就要跟大家道別了，我只是想謝謝你一路以來的幫忙。

column1: Don't mention it, bwoy! Iffn ah kin do anything to make yer departure more hasty or pleasant, feel free to ask!
column2: 別客氣，小子！要是俺能幫你走得更快或更痛快點，儘管開口！

column1: Sheriff, I'll be leaving shortly. Thanks for the ammo and cleaning supplies.
column2: 警長，我馬上就要走了。謝謝你給的彈藥和清潔用品。

column1: Yep, yep, sure, sure, glad to help, whutever yew say, bon voi-ah-gee.
column2: 對對對，沒問題沒問題，樂意效勞，你說了算，一路順風啦。

column1: Yeah? Do I know you?
column2: 啊？我認識你嗎？

column1: I'm Fr... I mean, I'm 'fraid you've got a problem.
column2: 我是佛……我是說，我恐怕你有麻煩了。

column1: Oh, do I? What problem would that be? Seems to me mah BIGGEST problem already left town! Jus' got a lotta little ones left.
column2: 哦，是嗎？什麼麻煩？俺看哪，俺最大的麻煩已經離開鎮上了！剩下的都是些小麻煩。

column1: You've got an infamous riverboat gambler in your Saloon, gambling up people's property.
column2: 你的酒館裡有個惡名昭彰的河船賭徒，把大夥的財產都給賭光了。

column1: Nothin' illegal 'bout that. Nobuddy's forcin' anyone to gamble.
column2: 這又不犯法。又沒人逼誰去賭。

column1: But he's CHEATING!
column2: 可是他出老千！

column1: Welp, I spoze if yew wuz to CATCH him cheatin', ah might have to run him in. But he's very good, ah don't think yew'll catch him. He came highly recommended.
column2: 呃，俺想要是你能當場逮到他出老千，俺大概就得把他抓起來。不過他手法很高明，俺看你抓不到他的。他可是有人大力推薦來的。

column1: Nothin', nothin'.
column2: 沒事，沒事。

column1: I'm going to have to bring that gambler to justice!
column2: 我非得把那個賭徒繩之以法不可！

column1: Hey, mister, ah don't want any trouble 'round here. Don't yew go shootin' nobody, I'll hafta run you in. Yew let thangs take their nacheral course.
column2: 嘿，老兄，俺可不想這裡出亂子。你可別對誰開槍，不然俺就得抓你了。事情就順其自然吧。

column1: Hey, Sheriff Shift!
column2: 嘿，席夫特警長！

column1: Well, if it ain't the fella whut caught "Aces" Hall! Whussup?
column2: 這不是抓到「王牌」霍爾的那位嘛！有事嗎？

column1: Don't you know? Your entire town is being shot up by a bunch of rowdy cowhands!
column2: 你不知道嗎？整個鎮都被一群鬧事的牛仔開槍打得亂七八糟！

column1: Yep! Aren't it awful? Evvabuddy in town who don't git shot up is gonna git skeered away! HAW HAW! I hate it!
column2: 沒錯！是不是很糟糕？鎮上沒被打中的人，大概都會被嚇跑！哈哈哈！俺可真是討厭死了！

column1: I don't understand. Why do you want everyone to leave Coarsegold so badly?
column2: 我不懂。你為什麼這麼想讓所有人都離開粗金鎮？

column1: Oh, it ain't ME, Stranger. It's m'boss, the one who already owns half the property in town and wants the rest of it.
column2: 喔，才不是俺想的呢，陌生人。是俺老闆，他已經擁有鎮上一半的地產，現在想要剩下的那一半。

column1: But why? Why would anyone want a broken-down piece of underdeveloped property like Coarsegold?
column2: 可是為什麼？誰會想要粗金鎮這種破破爛爛、又沒開發的地方？

column1: Ah'm afeared that ain't none of yer business, pard.
column2: 恐怕這不干你的事，朋友。

column1: Well? Are you going to stop those rowdy cowhands?
column2: 那，你打算阻止那些鬧事的牛仔嗎？

column1: Hell no, bwoy! Ah'm gonna let 'em do their business, then ah'm gonna collect m'cut and git outta this town! And ah'd advise YEW to do the same!
column2: 才不咧，小子！俺要讓他們把事情辦完，然後俺拿了自己那一份就閃人！俺勸你也照做！

column1: Hey hey hey, bwoy! Don't be tichin' me. We's a pretty macho bunch in this town... iff'n yew don't know thet by now, yew better lern pretty quick! Leastways, not with the window open!
column2: 嘿嘿嘿，小子！別碰俺。俺們這鎮上的人可個個都很男子氣概……你要是還不知道，最好快點搞懂！至少也別把窗戶開著做這種事！

column1: Yew tryin' to peddle yer potions door-to-door, Phartkis?
column2: 你這是想挨家挨戶兜售你那些藥水嗎，法特凱斯？

column1: No, no, this is Dad Gumm's Elixir. I found it on his wagon; I don't even carry the stuff.
column2: 不不，這是老岡姆的萬靈藥。我在他的貨車上找到的，我根本沒在賣這東西。

column1: Welp, that's fine, bwoy, yew jus' hang onto it. Wouldn't want one of children gettin' ahold of it, would we?
column2: 呃，那就好，小子，你自己收好吧。俺們可不希望哪個小孩拿到手，對吧？

column1: Why, that's ol' Doc Gillespie's whisky glass! I'd rekanize that anywheres! Whut you doin' with it, Pharmakas?
column2: 咦，那是老吉勒斯比大夫的威士忌杯！俺到哪都認得出來！你拿著它幹嘛，法瑪卡斯？

column1: I'm saving him from himself.
column2: 我是要救他脫離自己的壞習慣。

column1: Thet's the stoopidest thang I ever heard. Cain't save someone frum themSELF. How could yew git away?
column2: 這是俺聽過最蠢的話了。人怎麼可能救自己脫離自己呢。你這套說詞怎麼混得過去？

column1: That's a fine bit o' detective work, bwoy! Yew get sum big-time points fer that one?
column2: 這下你偵探工作做得不錯嘛，小子！這件事有讓你拿到不少大分數吧？

column1: Sure did!
column2: 那當然！

column1: Well, thet's fine, jes' fine. Now skedaddle on back to yer Pharmacy there, Pharsky, an' I'll be over in a li'l while.
column2: 好啊，那就好，那就好。現在快滾回你的藥局吧，法斯基，俺待會就過去。

column1: I cain't read thet, Pharphetcht. Yew know ain't nobody 'round here kin read that ol' drunk's chicken scratchin'. And say, that reminds me. Ah'm gonna be stopping 'round at the Pharmacy a little later. Hope yew don't mind. Thet's fine, bwoy, jus' fine. Ah'll be seeing you later, then.
column2: 俺看不懂這個，法菲切特。你知道這鎮上沒人看得懂那個醉鬼的鬼畫符。對了，這倒提醒俺了。俺待會會去藥局那邊晃晃，希望你別介意。那就好，小子，那就好。待會見啦。

column1: Need anything for your piles, Sheriff?
column2: 需要點什麼治痔瘡的藥嗎，警長？

column1: If I WANTED sumpin' fer m'piles, I'da come inna yer store and AST ya fer sumpin'! Which reminds me, ah'll be payin' yew a visit shortly. Yew best be in when I gets there.
column2: 俺要是想治痔瘡，自然會進你店裡開口跟你要！這倒提醒俺了，俺待會會去拜訪你，你最好乖乖在店裡等著。

column1: Certainly, Sheriff. Anything to help.
column2: 當然，警長。樂意效勞。

column1: That's whut yew say now! HAW HAW HAW!
column2: 你現在是這麼說的！哈哈哈！

column1: Ah don't drink beer on duty, bwoy!
column2: 俺執勤時不喝啤酒的，小子！

column1: It's nothing but water. I took it from the water tower.
column2: 這只是水而已。我從水塔裡打來的。

column1: Then ah SURELY doesn't wanna drink it.
column2: 那俺可就更不想喝了。

column1: Why, Sheriff? Do you know if there's something WRONG with the water? Could somebody have done something TO it? Something YOU know all about?
column2: 怎麼了，警長？你是不是知道水有什麼問題？是不是有人對水動了什麼手腳？一件你一清二楚的事？

column1: Quit yellin' at me, bwoy! I don't know whut yer squawkin' about! Git outta mah face! G'wan witcha! Scat!
column2: 別對俺大呼小叫的，小子！俺不知道你在鬼扯什麼！從俺眼前滾開！走開！滾！

column1: Hmmm. He seems just a slight bit defensive.
column2: 嗯……他看起來還真有點心虛的樣子。

column1: Shoot, bwoy, I wouldn't give yew a plugged nickel. Yew kin jus' go beggin' elsewheres.
column2: 呿，小子，俺一毛都不會給你。你要討飯就去別的地方吧。

column1: HEY HEY HEY! Tryin' to stab a Sheriff is grounds fer inkarserayshun!
column2: 嘿嘿嘿！敢拿刀捅警長，足夠讓你去蹲苦牢了！

column1: I was merely showing it to you.
column2: 我只是拿給你看看而已。

column1: Well, criminey, bwoy, ah've seen ice picks before! Now vamoose, before I change muh mind and toss you in the hoosegow fer attemptin' to aerate an officer of the law!
column2: 唉呦，小子，俺又不是沒見過冰錐！現在快滾，免得俺改變主意，把你扔進大牢，罪名是企圖在執法人員身上「通風」！

column1: Walll, lookee whut yew got. Charcoal. Yew plannin' on makin' a homemade bomb, mebbe? Gonna blow up the Ol' Abandoned Mine or sumpin'? Fella kin get inna lotta trouble, messin' around with dynamite. Take yer hand right off.
column2: 哦，瞧瞧你拿了什麼。木炭啊。你該不會想自製炸彈吧？打算把那座廢棄舊礦坑炸了還是怎樣？小子亂搞炸藥可是會惹上大麻煩的。手還會被炸飛咧。

column1: Here's some advice fer ya, friend-to-friend, guy. Don't go tryin' to make no dynamite. Find a peaceful use fer that charcoal. You'll breathe easier. 'Nuff said!
column2: 俺這是朋友對朋友給你個建議，老兄。別想著要做炸藥。找個和平點的用途給那塊木炭吧。你會活得輕鬆點。就這樣，別多說了！

column1: HAW HAW HYUK! If that ain't the PUNIEST lookin' whip I ever did see!
column2: 哈哈哈！那真是俺看過最遜的鞭子了！

column1: It's not a whip.
column2: 這不是鞭子。

column1: YER tellin' ME, bwoy!
column2: 這還用你講，小子！

column1: Whut in thunderation is thet thang?
column2: 那到底是啥鬼東西？

column1: It's a gas mask. It'll help you breathe safely until I get the horses cured.
column2: 這是防毒面具。在我治好那些馬之前，能讓你安全呼吸。

column1: Yer gonna cure them horses?
column2: 你要去治那些馬？

column1: Why, of course! That's what you want, isn't it? You don't want the poor folks of Coarsegold to choke to death, do you?
column2: 那當然囉！這不就是你要的嗎？你總不希望粗金鎮的鄉親們活活嗆死吧？

column1: (SPUTTERS) Well, I...
column2: （支支吾吾）這個，我…

column1: Well, Sheriff? I'm waiting for an answer. Is that what you want?
column2: 怎樣，警長？我等你回答。這是你要的嗎？

column1: (SPUTTERING) Why, I... I mean... you... I mean, NO! Of COURSE thet's not whut I want! An' anything you kin do to alleviate our current sichyation will be appershiated. MOST appershiated, Pharkle. Now take your little mask and git outta here. I got work ta do!
column2: （吞吞吐吐）這個，我…我是說…你…我是說，不！我當然不是那個意思！你能幫忙緩解咱們現在的狀況，老夫感激不盡。萬分感激，法克勒。現在把你那小面具收一收，滾出去。老夫還有正事要辦！

column1: Whaddaya call thet, Pharkwas?
column2: 你管那玩意兒叫啥，法克瓦？

column1: It's "deflatulizer." It'll cure the horses of their terminal flatulence.
column2: 這叫「除屁劑」，能治好馬兒的末期脹氣症。

column1: Oh. Well, thet's reallll good, bwoy, reallll good. You done the town a service. An' I ain't gorna forgit it. Nosiree bob. Ain't gorna forgit it.
column2: 喔。那可真是太好了，小子，真的太好了。你為鎮上立了大功。老夫不會忘記的。不，絕對不會忘。

column1: You like snails, Sheriff?
column2: 警長，你喜歡蝸牛嗎？

column1: I hates 'em! They're mean, slimy li'l critters.
column2: 老子恨死牠們了！那些黏答答的小畜生，壞透了。

column1: Takes one to know one, eh, Sheriff?
column2: 惺惺相惜嘛，對吧，警長？

column1: Whut? Quit talkin' crazy talk, bwoy. Yew bin out in the sun too long.
column2: 啥？別胡言亂語了，小子。你曬太陽曬太久了。

column1: Yer not tryin' to BRIBE me to let chew open yer store back up, are ya?
column2: 你該不會是想賄賂老子，讓你把店重新開張吧？

column1: What if I were?
column2: 如果我就是想呢？

column1: If yew wuz, I'd have to ARREST ya fer tryin' to bribe a SHERIFF! Then ah'd hafta toss ya in the HOOSEGOW! Then ah'd hafta HANG YA. So ah'll ask ya again, wuz yew tryin' to BRIBE me?
column2: 那老子就得以行賄警長的罪名逮捕你！然後把你丟進大牢！接著還得吊死你。所以老子再問一次，你是不是想賄賂老子？

column1: No. I was asking you to look at this money and give me your assessment of whether or not it's counterfeit.
column2: 不是。我是要請你看看這些錢，幫我鑑定一下是不是偽鈔。

column1: It ain't. And thank kyew so much fer askin'! Right proper of you.
column2: 不是偽鈔。謝謝你來問老子，真是有禮數。

column1: Ah never drinks when ah'm on-duty, bwoy. Whut kinda lawman yew think I AM, anyway?
column2: 老子當班從不喝酒，小子。你把老子當成哪門子的執法人員了？

column1: Yew think, jes 'cuz ah'm MEAN, I'm STOOPIT? Ah got loaded weapons here, bwoy! Ah gotta be alert! Cain't be out-drawin' no varmints wif a skull full o' MUSH, bwoy! Now git yer patootie OUTTA here 'fore ah has to remove it fer ya!
column2: 你以為老子兇就代表老子笨？老子這兒可有上了膛的傢伙，小子！得保持清醒才行！腦袋一團漿糊，怎麼跟壞蛋拔槍對決？現在把你的屁股挪出去，免得老子親自幫你挪！

column1: Yer not plannin' any vandalism with those thangs, are yew, bwoy?
column2: 你該不會是打算拿那些東西搞破壞吧，小子？

column1: Of course not, Sheriff! Do I look like the kind of person who'd break bottles frivolously, for target practice or something?
column2: 當然不會，警長！我看起來像是那種會沒事亂砸瓶子、練靶什麼的人嗎？

column1: I spoze not, yer too much of a goody-two-shoes fer thet, aintcha? Welp, jus' keep those away from the kids. Dang vandals, every one of 'em.
column2: 老子猜也是，你這種乖寶寶哪幹得出那種事。好吧，離小孩遠一點就成。那些搞破壞的，個個都欠教訓。

column1: Sheriff Shift eyes you suspiciously.
column2: 席夫特警長狐疑地盯著你。

column1: 'Zat YER key, bwoy? Yer not STEALIN' no keys now, are ya?
column2: 那是你的鑰匙嗎，小子？你該不會是在偷鑰匙吧？

column1: Sheriff! Do I look like the kind of person who'd steal ANYthing?
column2: 警長！我看起來像是那種會偷東西的人嗎？

column1: Welp... I spoze ya don't. In fact, ya look too chicken to steal a kiss from a miss.
column2: 呃……老子猜不像。老實說，你膽子小得連跟姑娘偷個吻都不敢。

column1: Thet looks suspiciously lahk the ladder Miz Primm wuz sayin' wuz taken from the schoolhouse playground! Lemme see the serial number on thet ladder.
column2: 那東西看起來很像潘妮洛普小姐說被人從校園裡偷走的梯子！讓老子瞧瞧那梯子的編號。

column1: There isn't any serial number. I, uh, made it m'self.
column2: 沒有編號。這個嘛，是我自己做的。

column1: Oh. Well, thet's OK, then. Carry on, bwoy.
column2: 喔。那就沒事了。繼續吧，小子。

column1: Yew tryin' to tie me up, bwoy?
column2: 你想把老子綁起來嗎，小子？

column1: No, I'm trying the old rope-a-dope trick.
column2: 不是，我只是在練那招老套的「以柔克剛」。

column1: That's boxin', bwoy, not ropin'! HAR! Yew pretty dumb, yew know thet?
column2: 那是拳擊術語，小子，不是套繩！哈！你還真夠笨的，知道嗎？

column1: Jumpin' Jehosophat, bwoy, yew tryin' to hogtie me?
column2: 我的老天爺啊，小子，你想把老子五花大綁？

column1: What if I am?
column2: 如果我就是想呢？

column1: Walp, ah'd say you were pretty pitiful with a lasso!
column2: 呃，老子只能說你套繩的本事還真夠遜的！

column1: Whut you got there?
column2: 你那兒拿的是啥？

column1: It's a water purification solution. It'll help alleviate the town's gastric troubles.
column2: 這是淨水劑，能幫忙緩解鎮上的腸胃問題。

column1: Lemme git this straight. That there stuff's gonna alleviate the town's gastric troubles?
column2: 讓老子搞清楚。那玩意兒能緩解鎮上的腸胃問題？

column1: Uh, I believe that's what I just said. That IS what you want, isn't it? You don't WANT the whole town to die of dehydration from excessive diarrhea, do you?
column2: 呃，我剛剛好像就是這麼說的。這不就是你要的嗎？你總不希望全鎮的人都因為拉肚子拉到脫水而死吧？

column1: <Sputter>
column2: 〈支吾〉

column1: I mean, nobody would've PURPOSEFULLY poisoned the town's drinking water, right? So I wouldn't be BOTHERING anybody by purifying the water, would I?
column2: 我是說，總不會有人故意在鎮上的飲用水裡下毒吧？所以我把水淨化一下，應該不會惹到誰吧？

column1: You... I mean, the whole... That is... Well, NO, for corn sake, that's just PERFECT, Pharquar, just flippin' PERFECT. Go ahead an' CURE the whole dang town. That's right neighborly of you. RIGHT neighborly.
column2: 你…我是說，整個…那個…好吧，不，老天爺啊，這下真是「太完美」了，法夸爾，簡直完美到家。你就儘管去把全鎮的人都「治好」吧。真是敦親睦鄰啊。敦親睦鄰。

column1: Yew tryin' to gas me with thet thang?
column2: 你是想拿那玩意兒毒死老子嗎？

column1: Yes, only I can't get it open. Would you open it for me?
column2: 是啊，只是我打不開。能幫我開一下嗎？

column1: Whut, so's you kin turn around and gas me with it? Hyuk, hyuk, yew must be dumber than yew look!
column2: 啥，好讓你回頭拿去毒老子？嘿嘿，你比看起來還笨啊！

column1: Ha, ha! But not dumber than YOU look, right, Sheriff?
column2: 哈哈！但總沒你看起來那麼笨吧，警長？

column1: Haw haw! Yer darn tootin', bwoy, darn tootin'!
column2: 哈哈！你說得真對，小子，真對！

column1: Whoa there, son! You must have some whopper of a bellyache there!
column2: 哇喔，小子！你這肚子疼得可不輕啊！

column1: Actually, I was kinda hoping I could bury you underneath all this baking soda.
column2: 其實，我是想把你埋在這堆小蘇打底下。

column1: Hyuk hyuk hyuk! You ain't gotta snowman's chance in hell of doin' THET, bwoy! Ah may be short, but I'se wirey!
column2: 嘿嘿嘿！你休想辦得到，小子！老子個頭雖矮，但筋骨可硬得很！

column1: Say, these are sum purty li'l fillies!
column2: 哎呀，這些小馬駒兒還真俊俏！

column1: Yes, would you be willing to trade something for 'em?
column2: 是啊，你願意拿東西跟我換嗎？

column1: Nope! Got m'self a photographic memory. Got 'em all memorized. Thanks much, bwoy!
column2: 不用！老子過目不忘，全都記在腦子裡了。多謝了，小子！

column1: Yew fixin' to do sum candle-makin'?
column2: 你打算做蠟燭嗎？

column1: Walp, nice to know you gotcherself a hobby. Everbuddy needs a hobby. Y'know whut my hobby is?
column2: 呃，知道你有個嗜好挺好的。人人都該有個嗜好。你知道老子的嗜好是啥嗎？

column1: It's makin' life miserbul for pipsqueaks. Yew know whut a pipsqueak is, dontcher?
column2: 就是讓那些小屁孩過得生不如死。你知道啥叫小屁孩吧？

column1: Gooood. Word to the wise, Furpiece. Catch ya later, bwoy.
column2: 很好。給你個忠告，法皮斯。回頭見了，小子。

column1: HEY NOW! Yew jabbin' thet thang at me!
column2: 喂，搞什麼！你拿那玩意兒戳老子！

column1: No, no, I wasn't.
column2: 不，不，我沒有。

column1: THERE! Yew done it AGAIN!
column2: 你看！你又來了！

column1: No, no, no. I'm just practicing my knifework.
column2: 不，不，不。我只是在練刀法。

column1: Welp, take it OUTSIDE, bwoy! Take it OUTSIDE! Jehosophat, bwoy, iffn I didn't know yew wuz a chicken, ah'd thank yew wuz tryin' to ventilate muh spleen!
column2: 呃，拿到外頭去練，小子！到外頭去！老天爺啊，小子，要不是老子知道你是個膽小鬼，還真以為你想在老子脾臟上開個洞呢！

column1: Now jus' hold on a cotton-pickin' minute. Yew mean to tell me that yew, some kinda Western Hero, is jus' gonna walk in and shoot the Sheriff in cold blood? No fair fight, no shootout in the middle of the street, no nothin'? Does that sound like a act of a Hero? Or does it sound like the act of a coward?
column2: 等等，先別急。你的意思是，你這個自稱西部英雄的傢伙，竟然打算大搖大擺走進來，冷血地把警長給斃了？沒有公平對決，沒有街頭槍戰，啥都沒有？這聽起來像英雄幹的事嗎？還是像懦夫幹的事？

column1: Uh, coward, I guess.
column2: 呃，我猜是懦夫吧。

column1: Yew bet your boots. Let's just pretend that whole thang didn't happen, shall we? Let's see if yew kin get through this whole thang without shootin' anyone outright. 'Kay? 'Kay.
column2: 那還用說。咱們就當這件事沒發生過，成不？看看你能不能撐過這整齣戲，一槍都不用開。成吧？成。

column1: Here you go, Sheriff. Another nice, hot cup of coffee.
column2: 給你，警長。又一杯熱騰騰的好咖啡。

column1: Yew blind, bwoy? Cain't you see ah've already got a cuppa coffee here ah ain't drunken yet? Git that thing away fum me!
column2: 你瞎了嗎，小子？沒看到老子這兒還有杯沒喝完的咖啡？把那玩意兒拿開！

column1: I tole yuh, it's YERS, bwoy! Now take it and shimmy yer butt outta town afore we gotta shimmy it FER ya!
column2: 老子跟你說了，那是你的，小子！現在拿著它，自己滾出鎮去，免得老子動手幫你滾！

column1: I tole' ya, bwoy, those 'r on the house! Now take 'em and head on outta town, buckaroo, 'afore you git hurt.
column2: 老子跟你說了，小子，那些是招待的！現在拿著，滾出鎮去，牛仔小子，免得你受皮肉之苦。

column1: You toss the clay at the Sheriff.
column2: 你把黏土扔向警長。

column1: What in tarnation? Hey, Pharmhouse! Dontcha be throwin' yer mudpies at ME, bwoy! Hell's bells, son, g'wan back ter elementary skool iffn yer gonna start playin' wif clay! Geeeeez. I dunno why we's even worrying about this fool, he's jus' a case of arrested develupmint.
column2: 搞什麼鬼？喂，法姆好斯！別拿你那泥巴餅往老子身上扔，小子！老天爺啊，小子，你要玩黏土就滾回小學去玩！老天，老子真不懂大夥兒幹嘛還替這蠢貨操心，這傢伙根本是發育不良的案例。

column1: Wail, ah'll be a monkey's uncle. Gotcherself a holda some real silver there, ain'tcha?
column2: 哎呀，真是太陽打西邊出來了。你手上這玩意兒是真銀吧？

column1: I believe it is, yes.
column2: 我相信是真的，沒錯。

column1: Well, if thet ain't sumpin' special. Y'all mus' be as pleased as punch. Why don't you CELERBATE, bwoy, by gittin' OUTTA TOWN BY SUNDOWN? I think thet's a RIGHT good idea! A change of scenery do you a WORLD o' good, bwoy. Might even save yer life! HAW HAW HAW! Hyukhyukhyukhyuk!
column2: 哎呀，這可真是了不得。你一定樂歪了吧。要不趁著這股高興勁兒，小子，天黑前滾出鎮去，好好慶祝一番？老子覺得這主意好極了！換個環境對你有百利無一害，小子。搞不好還能保你一命呢！哈哈哈！嘿嘿嘿嘿！

column1: You outdone yerself fer stoopidness this time, bwoy. Thet's the dumbest-lookin' silver ear I ever seen. It's all crooked and ugly.
column2: 你這次可真是蠢到出神入化了，小子。那是老子見過最蠢的銀耳朵，又歪又醜。

column1: I guess you would know, wouldn't you, Sheriff?
column2: 我猜這方面你最有經驗了吧，警長？

column1: Why, thet there's a fine, spankin' new turquoise 'n beige cowboy suit yew got there, sonny bwoy! Didjer MOMMY sew it fer ya? HYUK HYUK HAW! HYUK HYUK HAW!
column2: 哎呀，你身上這套嶄新的松綠配米黃牛仔裝可真體面啊，乖寶寶！是你老媽幫你縫的嗎？嘿嘿哈！嘿嘿哈！

column1: That's a very good donkey imitation, Sheriff. Do you do horses?
column2: 那頭驢子叫模仿得真像，警長。馬叫你也會模仿嗎？

column1: The Sheriff stops laughing and eyes you narrowly.
column2: 警長止住笑聲，瞇眼盯著你。

column1: Don't be wisin' off to me, Paraquat. I got yer number, see? I bin keepin' my eye on yew. And let me tell yew sumpin'. I don't lahk yew. Yer a do-goodin', high-falutin' sunnuva gun, and we don't lahk yer kind in these parts. So watch yer back, bwoy. I'm watchin' yew. I'm ALWAYS watchin' yew.
column2: 別跟老子耍嘴皮子，巴拉刈。老子早就把你看透了，懂嗎？老子一直盯著你。跟你說件事，老子不喜歡你。你這個假仁假義、自命清高的傢伙，咱們這一帶不歡迎你這種人。所以最好小心點，小子。老子盯著你呢。老子隨時都盯著你。

column1: Y'all should be stoppin' back on Tuesday, bwoy! Yor boots'll be ready then! HYUK HYUK! Just joshin' ya, son, ah dunno where this thang come from.
column2: 你星期二該再來一趟，小子！到時你的靴子就好了！嘿嘿！開玩笑的啦，小子，老子也不知道這玩意兒打哪兒來的。

column1: Them's sum pretty dooded-up boots ya gots there, son! Them suckers your'n?
column2: 你這雙靴子打扮得真花俏啊，小子！那雙傢伙是你的嗎？

column1: A-yep. I mean, yes.
column2: 呃，對啊。我是說，沒錯。

column1: Well, well, well! Mebbe I misjudged ya. Mebbe wif them stunnin' turquoise 'n beige boots, yer a real honest-to-gorsh GUNSLINGER! HAW HAW HAW!
column2: 哎呀呀！也許老子看走眼了。憑著那雙亮眼的松綠配米黃靴子，你搞不好還真是個道地的槍手呢！哈哈哈！

column1: I think you're being sarcastic.
column2: 我覺得你是在諷刺我。

column1: Wal shoot, bwoy, mebbe ah am, mebbe ah ain't. It kinda depends on what "sarcastic" means.
column2: 呃，小子，也許是，也許不是。這要看「諷刺」是啥意思了。

column1: My, my! Whut a purty hanky you got there!
column2: 哎唷喂！你那條手帕真水啊！

column1: It's my lucky neckerchief, not a hanky.
column2: 那是我的幸運領巾，不是手帕。

column1: Well, whutever yew callin' it, bwoy, it's right purty. Why, you could even sop up yer own blood with it if yew had to! That IS a lucky hanky, ain't it? Let's hope you never gotta do nuthin' like that! It'd be a shame to stain such a purty hanky! Wouldn't it now? Hyuk hyuk haw!
column2: 呃，不管你叫它啥，小子，反正挺俊俏的。要真有需要，你還能拿它擦自己的血呢！那可真是條幸運手帕啊，對吧？但願你永遠用不上那種場合！把這麼俊俏的手帕給弄髒了，多可惜啊！對吧？嘿嘿哈！

column1: This thang ain't got no pictures or conversations innit! Whut the devil's the use of a letter wifout pictures or conversations innit? Bor-ring, Pharmhand, bor-ring!
column2: 這玩意兒裡頭沒圖也沒對話！一封信要是沒圖沒對話，到底有啥用啊？無聊，法姆漢，無聊透頂！

column1: Whoa there! Yew almost took mah head off with thet there shovel!
column2: 哇喔！你那把鏟子差點把老子的頭給削了！

column1: Oh, sorry. Let me try again. I'm sure I can get it right this time.
column2: 喔，抱歉。讓我再試一次，這回肯定能弄對。

column1: Whut? Stop talkin' garbage, bwoy. You'se stoopit.
column2: 啥？別胡說八道了，小子。你真夠蠢的。

column1: Pharkist! Whut the Sam Hill are yew tryin' to do, gas me? Ah'm sufferin' as it is, whut with m'front window permanently open! Take that bagga gas outta here 'afore I pass out!
column2: 法克斯特！你這是想幹啥，毒死老子嗎？老子現在已經夠受罪了，前窗還永遠關不緊！快把那袋毒氣拿走，免得老子昏過去！

column1: Here, Sheriff. I thought you might like to try putting this bag over your head. It'll make your appearance more pleasing.
column2: 給，警長。我想你或許會想把這袋子套在頭上試試，能讓你的模樣順眼一點。

column1: Pharmakus, iffn ah didn't know better, I'd swear you'se tryin' to insult me. But yer not clever enuf fer that, areya?
column2: 法馬克斯，要不是老子夠了解你，還真會以為你在羞辱老子呢。不過你也沒那份聰明才智，對吧？

column1: No, Sheriff, I'm much too much of a dullard for that.
column2: 沒有，警長，我這人太笨了，做不出那種事。

column1: Yeah, thet's whut I thought.
column2: 嗯，老子也是這麼想的。

column1: Pharsight! Yew are a sick pig, yew know thet? Take that maggot-infested thang outta this here govermint office 'afore I has to THROW you out!
column2: 法賽特！你這人真是個變態，知道嗎？把那長蛆的玩意兒拿出這間官署，免得老子把你扔出去！

column1: Walp, if this ain't the stoopidest hunk o' lost-wax castin' I ever did see! An ear? Who you fixin' to fool with THAT thang, Pharkum?
column2: 呃，這可真是老子見過最蠢的脫蠟鑄件了！一隻耳朵？你打算拿那玩意兒去唬弄誰啊，法克姆？

column1: I know I could never put one over on YOU, Sheriff.
column2: 我知道我絕對騙不過你，警長。

column1: You kin bet yer boots -- I sez, you kin bet yer boots -- on THAT!
column2: 這你儘管放心──老子說，這你儘管放心──絕對錯不了！

column1: Well lookee here, it's arts and crafts time with everbuddy's favorite Pharmacist! Thet's a loverly piece of clay-and-wax sculpture there, bwoy! Yew gonna go FAR! And if you don't git outta town SOON, yew gonna go farther then yew THOUGHT! HAR HAR HYUK!
column2: 哎喲瞧瞧，大夥兒最愛的藥師先生要來上美勞課啦！那件黏土蠟像做得真可愛啊，小子！你前途無量哦！要是不快點滾出鎮去，你的「前途」可比你想的還遠呢！哈哈嘿！

column1: Well, looks like yew'll have a new line o' work onct you git outta town, bwoy... carvin' prosthesises! That is, iffn yew git outta town IN ONE PIECE! Haw haw haw!
column2: 呃，看來你滾出鎮之後倒是能改行了，小子……去雕義肢！前提是你能全鬚全尾地滾出去！哈哈哈！

column1: Tryin' to POISON me, bwoy? Do I LOOK sick? I don't THANK I look sick! Wuz I sick wiffout mah KNOWIN' it?
column2: 想毒死老子嗎，小子？老子看起來像生病嗎？老子可不覺得自己看起來有病！難道老子病了自己還不知道？

column1: Yew bet yer prescription-filling BEHIND yew don't thank so! Now don't you be slippin' me none of yer medications agin, or ah'll be VERY unhappy witchoo. Yew hear me, bwoy?
column2: 你那配藥的屁股最好搞清楚，老子才不覺得！以後別再偷塞你那些藥給老子了，不然老子會非常不高興。聽到沒，小子？

column1: I hear ya.
column2: 聽到了。

column1: GOOD!
column2: 很好！

column1: The Sheriff's big old desk is cluttered with all sorts of crime-fighting paraphernalia... just in case the Sheriff decides to fight some crime someday.
column2: 警長那張又大又舊的辦公桌上，堆滿了各式各樣的緝凶用具……以防哪天警長心血來潮真想去抓壞人。

column1: Keep your hands offn m'crap, Parakwat.
column2: 你的手離老子的破爛玩意兒遠一點，巴拉刈。

column1: Pharkas.
column2: 法卡斯。

column1: Whutever.
column2: 隨便啦。

column1: Sheriff Shrift has tastefully decorated his window in the fashionable "Noveau Leavenworth" style.
column2: 席夫特警長把他的窗戶，用時下流行的「新監獄風」品味地裝飾了一番。

column1: Them there bars're mortared in place nice and tight, bwoy! No amount of tuggin's gone budge 'em. Jes' give that one up right NOW.
column2: 那些鐵條可是用水泥牢牢固定住的，小子！你再怎麼拉扯也動不了分毫。這念頭現在就給老子打消。

column1: That's the jail cell, where Sheriff Checkum ("Chicken") P. Shift tosses the bad guys. With the town's population dwindling, there haven't been many occupants lately.
column2: 那是牢房，外號「膽小雞」的切克姆·P·席夫特警長專門把壞蛋扔進去的地方。隨著鎮上人口日漸凋零，近來牢房裡也沒什麼房客了。

column1: Yew wantin' to spend a night in the hoosegow, son? I think that can be arranged, hyuk hyuk!
column2: 你想在大牢裡過一夜嗎，小子？老子看這事兒可以安排，嘿嘿！

column1: It's supposed to look like authentic Western masonry, but it's really a fiberglass polymer, nice and light and perfect for Western sets like these.
column2: 這看起來像是道地的西部石造工法，但其實是玻璃纖維聚合材質，輕巧好用，最適合這種西部場景了。

column1: They're cee-mented in place, Pharkberg. Do yer worst, y'cain't hardly move 'em.
column2: 那些是用水泥固定死的，法克伯格。你使出渾身解數也休想搬得動。

column1: Technically, the fiberglass polymer set is all one piece, so you can't move it.
column2: 嚴格說來，這整組玻璃纖維聚合材質是一體成形的，所以你搬不動。

column1: Those are the Sheriff's six-guns. Actually, they're revolvers and rifles... but there are six of them!
column2: 那些是警長的「六響槍」。其實是左輪手槍和步槍啦……不過總共有六把！

column1: Hey, Porkers! Them's my official shootin' irons, an' yew don't wanna be touchin' 'em. I could clap you in irons fer thet.
column2: 喂，波克斯！那些是老子官配的傢伙，你可別亂碰。老子可以為此把你銬起來。

column1: This looks like a table.
column2: 這看起來像張桌子。

column1: Yew break it, yew bought it! Hyuk, hyuk.
column2: 弄壞了就得照價賠！嘿嘿。

column1: The Sheriff keeps this lamp lit so's he can read his procedural manuals and see the pictures REAL good.
column2: 警長讓這盞燈一直亮著，好讓他能看清他那些辦案手冊，尤其是裡頭的圖片。

column1: Leave it be, Pharmint, I gotta see muh penal diagrams good.
column2: 別碰，法明特，老子得把那些刑罰圖表看清楚才行。

column1: The Sheriff hung his hat and long coat on the rack.
column2: 警長把帽子和長大衣掛在架子上。

column1: Y'all jus' leave them duds alone, bwoy. You knows I like you, bwoy, but you go pokin' 'round in a man's privates, I takes your hand off in nuthin' flat, bwoy, jus' like that.
column2: 你就別去碰那些衣物了，小子。你知道老子挺喜歡你的，小子，但你要是敢去摸一個男人的私人物件，老子二話不說就把你的手剁了，小子，就是這麼回事。

column1: Some of the Sheriff's law-and-order books: PentUpHouse, Letters to PentUpHouse, PentUpHouse Pets, PentUpHouse Forum, Female Convicts in Bondage, Babes 'n Bars, and Debbie Does Cell Block D.
column2: 警長的部分執法藏書：《壓抑之屋》、《致壓抑之屋的信》、《壓抑之屋寵物》、《壓抑之屋論壇》、《女囚受縛記》、《鐵窗辣妹》，還有《黛比大戰D區牢房》。

column1: Leave 'em be, Pharkmeister, y'all ain't got no business stickin' your nose in mah penal codes.
column2: 別碰，法克大師，你沒必要把鼻子伸進老子的刑法書裡。

column1: This is where the Sheriff keeps his trade journals.
column2: 這裡是警長存放他那些行業期刊的地方。

column1: Hey! Pharberg! Y'all keep yer hands offn mah bookshelves.
column2: 喂！法伯格！你的手離老子的書架遠一點。

column1: Wouldja mind not tearin' that down, Pharkem? I ain't caught that critter yet.
column2: 你介不介意別把那東西扯下來，法克恩？老子那隻小畜生還沒逮著呢。

column1: It's an old Register clock.
column2: 這是一座老舊的收銀鐘。

column1: It don't need windin', Barkus, it's one of them clocks what winds itself from the constant vibrations of California's shaky tectonic plates.
column2: 那不需要上發條，巴克斯，那是靠加州地殼板塊持續晃動來自動上鏈的鐘。

column1: This turn-of-the-century Sheriff's office is manned by a real turn-of-the-century Sheriff.
column2: 這間世紀之交的警長辦公室，坐鎮著一位貨真價實、世紀之交的警長。

column1: You can't commune with the environment in that fashion.
column2: 你沒辦法用那種方式跟這裡的環境溝通。

column1: Whut choo lookin' for, bwoy?
column2: 你在找啥，小子？

column1: That's an old trunk, dated back to the 1870s. Actually, in that case, it's pretty new!
column2: 那是個老舊的箱子，年代可追溯到1870年代。不過這樣算起來，其實還挺新的！

column1: If yew get that thang open, Pharkly, let me know. It's bin locked fer years. Nuttin' in it, as fur as I know.
column2: 你要是能把那玩意兒打開，法克利，記得告訴老子一聲。那東西鎖了好多年了。據老子所知，裡頭啥也沒有。

column1: That's the key to the Pharmacy, not the key to this trunk. There IS no key to this trunk! It can't be opened!
column2: 那是藥局的鑰匙，不是這箱子的鑰匙。這箱子根本沒有鑰匙！打不開的！

column1: You can't open the trunk with the ice pick. In fact, you can't open the trunk at all.
column2: 你沒辦法用冰錐打開這箱子。事實上，這箱子根本打不開。

column1: That key doesn't work with this trunk. Anyway, there's nothing in the trunk.
column2: 那把鑰匙開不了這箱子。反正箱子裡也沒東西。

column1: There's no need to pry the trunk open with the knife. There's nothing inside the trunk.
column2: 沒必要拿刀撬開這箱子。裡頭什麼都沒有。

column1: That's not a trunk key. In fact, there IS no key to this trunk. Just leave it alone.
column2: 那不是這箱子的鑰匙。事實上，這箱子根本沒有鑰匙。別管它了。

column1: That key won't open this trunk. There's nothing in this trunk anyway! Leave it alone!
column2: 那把鑰匙打不開這箱子。反正這箱子裡也沒東西！別管它了！

column1: There's no reason to shoot the trunk open. There's nothing inside.
column2: 沒必要開槍把箱子打開。裡頭什麼都沒有。

column1: This is the Sheriff's spittoon, where he gets most of his target practice.
column2: 這是警長的痰盂，他大部分的練靶都在這上頭。

column1: Drop it, Pharkenstein. I'm startin' a collection.
column2: 放下，科學怪法。老子正在收藏這玩意兒呢。

column1: Y'all mind leavin' thet thang up there? Whenever I feel m'self gettin' soft, I jes' look at that ugly varmint and get the ol' fires stoked up again.
column2: 你介不介意把那玩意兒留在原處？每當老子覺得自己心軟了，只要看一眼那隻醜東西，老火氣就又燒起來了。

column1: It's an old bucket. Sheriff Shift occasionally likes to soak his feet.
column2: 這是個舊水桶。席夫特警長偶爾喜歡拿來泡腳。

column1: Quit pokin' 'round in muh foot-soaking tub, Pharkblatt, unless you wuz goin' to soak muh feet fer me. Hyar, hyar!
column2: 別在老子的泡腳桶裡東摸西摸的，法克布拉特，除非你是想幫老子泡腳。嘿呀，嘿呀！

column1: Say, Sheriff! I know how much a law enforcement person like yourself enjoys a good hot cup of coffee every now and then.
column2: 話說，警長！我知道像你這樣的執法人員，偶爾就是喜歡來杯熱騰騰的好咖啡。

column1: Thanks, pardner! But 'cha know what? Sumptin sweet would shore taste good right now!
column2: 多謝了，夥計！不過你知道嗎？現在來點甜的肯定更對味！

column1: Why, I bet that's true. I'll be glad to try and find you something to munch on. But, in the meantime, I've been thinking about moving to another city. But, I've got no bullets. I was wondering if you have any bullets that would fit an old .45?
column2: 哎，我猜也是。我很樂意去幫你找點吃的。不過在這之前，我一直在考慮搬去別的城鎮。只是我手頭沒子彈，不曉得你有沒有能裝進老式點45手槍的子彈？

column1: Whey, shore, son. Here. Have a box o' these Remingtons! No charge; they're on the County.
column2: 哎呀，當然有，小子。拿去，這盒雷明頓子彈給你！不用錢，郡政府請客。

column1: Here's what you wanted, Sheriff. A nice hot cup of Mom's coffee.
column2: 這是你要的東西，警長。老媽餐館熱騰騰的好咖啡。

column1: Thanks, pardner! This'll shore go good wit' dat apple pie you gave me!
column2: 多謝了，夥計！這個配你剛給老子的蘋果派肯定絕配！

column1: You are most welcome, Sheriff. Say, you wouldn't happen to have a spare gun cleaning kit, would you? These old pistols of mine are dirty as sin!
column2: 不客氣，警長。話說，你該不會剛好有多的槍械保養工具吧？我這些老手槍髒得不像話！

column1: Okay, son. But this gun cleanin' kit'll be the last thing I give ya. Now git chur pistols cleaned, git chur horse packed up and git chur ass outta town!
column2: 好吧，小子。但這套保養工具是老子給你的最後一樣東西了。現在把你的手槍擦乾淨，把馬打點好，然後把你的屁股滾出鎮去！

column1: Here, Sheriff Shift. I know how much a law-enforcing person like yourself appreciates a good fatty dessert-like foodstuff for breakfast.
column2: 給，席夫特警長。我知道像你這樣的執法人員，早餐就是愛吃這種油滋滋、跟甜點沒兩樣的東西。

column1: Whey, thank cue! I bin so hongrey I coulda et a bear! But, do ya think I could git a cuppa coffee to go with this?
column2: 哎呀，多謝啦！老子餓得都能吞下一頭熊了！不過，能不能也給老子來杯咖啡配著吃？

column1: Why, sure, Sheriff. But, in the meantime, I've been thinking about moving to another city. But, I've got no bullets. I was wondering if you have any bullets that would fit an old .45?
column2: 哎，當然，警長。不過在這之前，我一直在考慮搬去別的城鎮。只是我手頭沒子彈，不曉得你有沒有能裝進老式點45手槍的子彈？

column1: Here you go, Sheriff Shift. I found some of Mom's nice hot apple pie for ya. I know how much a law-enforcing person like yourself enjoys sweet, fatty breakfasts.
column2: 給你，席夫特警長。我幫你找了些老媽餐館熱騰騰的蘋果派。我知道像你這樣的執法人員，早餐就愛吃甜甜膩膩的東西。

column1: Whey, thank cue! I bin so hongrey I coulda et a bear! This'll shore go good with that cuppa coffee ya brung me earlier!
column2: 哎呀，多謝啦！老子餓得都能吞下一頭熊了！這個配你剛才拿來的那杯咖啡肯定絕配！

column1: Uh, Sheriff? do you have anything I could use to clean these old guns of mine before I leave town? They're mighty dirty and I want to be prepared for my long journey!
column2: 呃，警長？在我離開鎮上之前，你有沒有什麼東西能讓我清理一下這些老槍？它們髒得很，我想為長途旅程做好準備！

column1: Okay, son. But this gun cleanin' kit'll be the last thing I give ya. Now git chur guns cleaned, git chur horse packed and git chur ass outta ma town!
column2: 好吧，小子。但這套保養工具是老子給你的最後一樣東西了。現在把你的槍擦乾淨，把馬打點好，然後把你的屁股滾出老子的鎮去！

column1: The Sheriff's favorite desk chair has, over the years, just about welded itself to the floor.
column2: 警長最愛的那張辦公椅，這些年下來幾乎已經和地板焊在一起了。

column1: You can't move the chair legs. They've become part of the floor. Sheriff Shift isn't exactly a go-getter.
column2: 你搬不動這椅腳，它們早就成了地板的一部分。席夫特警長可不是什麼幹勁十足的人。

column1: That's the stolen apple pie you gave Sheriff Shift.
column2: 那是你給席夫特警長的那個偷來的蘋果派。

column1: It ain't et yet!
column2: 還沒吃完呢！

column1: That's the cup of coffee you thoughtfully provided to the Sheriff.
column2: 那是你貼心送給警長的那杯咖啡。

column1: Ah'm not done drinkin' it yit, Pharquar!
column2: 俺還沒喝完哪，法夸爾！

column1: You see Penelope in a whole new light, now that you know what a cad and a bounder she is! That angelic face belies the vicious, calculating, cold-hearted murderer she really is! But, hoo boy, you still wouldn't mind those lips touching yours, and... NO! Stop thinking that way! She's a bad girl! BAD girl!
column2: 現在你才知道潘妮洛普是個多麼卑鄙無恥的人，對她的看法徹底改觀了！那張天使般的臉龐，竟然掩藏著一個心狠手辣、工於心計的冷血殺手！但是，哎呀，你心裡還是有點希望那雙唇碰上自己的，而且……不！別再這樣想了！她是個壞女人！壞女人！

column1: Can't we talk this over?
column2: 我們不能好好談談嗎？

column1: There's nothing to talk about. You've interfered with my plans once too often!
column2: 沒什麼好談的。你壞我的好事已經不是一次兩次了！

column1: There's no way you'll be able to grab her gun before she can pull the trigger.
column2: 你絕對來不及在她扣下扳機前搶下她的槍。

column1: A child's slate sits rests on a nearby desk.
column2: 一塊小朋友的石板擱在附近的書桌上。

column1: When I say "Drop 'em," I mean "Drop 'em!"
column2: 我說「放下傢伙」，意思就是「放下！」

column1: When Freddy stepped inside, Penelope wuz standin' at the desk, packin' in a hurry. She didn't even notice him come in. Gazin' at her like that, Freddy saw her fer the conniving snake-in-the-grass she really wuz.
